unresolved.legacyText: 乌尔戈兹是一个堕落的灵魂，也是埃科瓦尔德森林的前守护者。他曾经是一位高贵的守护者，保护森林和其中的所有生命，并与居住在那里的库兹克人一起维护森林的安全。然而，在玉风石化了大部分森林后，乌尔戈兹和他的守望者追随者开始腐化。它们对生活在森林中的人类的威胁与日俱增。
unresolved.englishDraft: UrgozA corrupt soul and a former guardian of the Ekowald forest. He was a noble guardian,PreservationThe forest and all its life, together with the Kuzk people living there, maintain the safety of the forest. However, after the jade winds have petrorated most of the forests, the forest is now being destroyed by the sea.UrgozAnd his watchmen and followers are starting to corrupt. Their threats to people living in forests are increasing.

unresolved.legacyText: 瘟疫侵袭凯珊，东悟与明月带领英雄追查白影的阴谋。凯珊新角色由星岬寺开始；其他篇章角色从北方码头进入凯宁城的剧情。
unresolved.englishDraft: The plague struck Kashan, and East Wing and the Moon led the heroes to pursue the White Shadow.Shing Jea Monastery Started; other chapters of the role from the North Pier into Kening City.

unresolved.legacyText: 地震与毁灭者威胁席卷泰瑞亚。英雄经地下通道逃至北方之眼，联合阿苏拉、诺恩和黑檀先锋队，对抗大毁灭者。
unresolved.englishDraft: The earthquake and the destroyer threaten to engulf Tyrea.Eye of the Northand united Assula, Noon and Black Honolulu to fight against the Great Destroyer.

unresolved.legacyText: 毁灭前的训练结束后，角色来到两年后的阿斯卡隆。鲁里克王子在夏尔入侵中组织抵抗，随后率难民越过席娃山脉；他在霜门的撤离途中牺牲。
unresolved.englishDraft: After the training before destruction had ended, the role arrived in Ascalon two years later. Prince Rouric organized resistance during the Shire invasion and then led refugees across the Siva Mountains; he died on his way to the fall of the Frost Gate.

unresolved.legacyText: 抵达科瑞塔后，英雄最初协助白斗篷抵御亡灵。追查获选者的去向时，他们发现白斗篷献祭无辜者，转而与光刃并肩作战；马基斯的背叛迫使众人撤离。
unresolved.englishDraft: When they arrive in Corita, heroes help the white cape to defend itself from the dead. When they track down those who have been selected, they find that the white cloak is a sacrifice for innocent people and instead fights with a bare blade;MarkisThe betrayal forced people to evacuate.

unresolved.legacyText: 在图瑞·欧萨的指引下，英雄通过三项试炼与镜像之战，进入巨龙格琳特的巢穴。格琳特揭示白斗篷主人是马赛特，并解释寻火者预言。
unresolved.englishDraft: Under the guidance of Turi Osa, heroes enter the nest of the giant Lungrint through three battles to test and mirror them. Gretel reveals that the owner of the white cloak is Marcelte and explains the fire-hunters.Prophecies。

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄营救光刃，与先知接触并获得灌注以抵御马赛特的幽灵痛苦，随后帮助矮人夺回雷云要塞。
unresolved.englishDraft: Hero rescues the blade, contacts the Prophet and gets injected to defend him from the ghost pain of Marset, then helps the dwarfs recover it.Thunderhead Keep。

unresolved.legacyText: 基尔布隆引导英雄破坏科马里之门的封印，释放泰坦。他随后暴露巫妖身份，试图借欧尔权杖控制泰坦。英雄最终击败巫妖，再次封闭大门。
unresolved.englishDraft: Kirblon led the hero to break the seal of the Comarie Gate and release Titan. He then exposed himself as a witch, trying to control Titan with his Orbian staff. The hero eventually defeated the demon and closed the gate again.

unresolved.legacyText: 主线结束后，格琳特指引英雄阻止失控泰坦袭击各地，并追击北方的泰坦首领。这是后续任务，不能与最终主线任务混为一项。
unresolved.englishDraft: After the end of the main line, Glynt led his hero to stop the uncontrolled Titan attacks and pursue the northern Titans. This is a follow-up mission that cannot be confused with the final main line mission.

unresolved.legacyText: 东悟与学生在曹大臣庄园发现瘟疫，追查至善台郡后辨认出白影的标记，随后赴凯宁城求援。
unresolved.englishDraft: Dong Go and students found plague at the Minister Cao Manor, traced it to Sen Tai County and identified the white shadow markings before going to Kening City for help.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄在薇茹广场被白影杀死，又由使者复活。为对抗灵魂与白影，他们完成纳普区的试炼，成为 Weh no Su，并在谭纳凯神殿释放古代英雄。
unresolved.englishDraft: The heroes were killed by the white shadows in Viru Square, and the Messenger was raised. They finished fighting against the soul and the white.Nahpui Quarter (explorable area)♪ The test, becomes Weh no SuAndTahnnakai Temple (explorable area) Release the ancient heroes.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄分别取得圣维克特骨灰瓮与阿克摩如斯长矛，在孙江行政区关闭裂隙，却得知圣物只能暂时阻止白影。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero gets the urn of St. Victor and the spear of Achmores,Sunjiang District (explorable area) Close the cracks, but it was learned that sacred objects could only temporarily stop the white shadow.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄可协助库兹柯守护永恒之林，或协助勒克森保护盖拉孵化所的幼龟。面对共同的瘟疫威胁，两方形成合作，故事在沉睡之水重新汇合。
unresolved.englishDraft: A hero can help keep Kuzko safe.The Eternal Grove (explorable area) Or help Lecson.PreservationGyala Hatchery (explorable area)The turtles. In the face of a common plague, we have a partnership.Unwaking Waters (explorable area)Reconnect.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄解除白影对盐蛟昆纳维的控制，攻入莱苏皇宫。东悟为救皇帝牺牲，白影借皇族之血重返人间；英雄随后在帝国圣所击败他。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero has removed the shadow from control of the salt Quinnawi and has invaded.Raisu Palace East Go is the king's salvation, and the shadow returns to the world with blood from the royal family; the hero is now in the house.Imperial Sanctum Beat him.

unresolved.legacyText: 日戟新兵抵御海盗，追查古代遗迹中的恶兆，发现科瑞纳将领卡叶特与海盗合作，并得知瓦蕾丝试图释放阿巴顿。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Japanese recruits resisted pirates, pursued the symptoms of ancient monuments, discovered that General Corina had taken Kait to cooperate with pirates and learned that Wallace was trying to release Abatton.

unresolved.legacyText: 日戟军在领事馆码头遭重创，转入地下抵抗。英雄救出同伴，穿过科瑞纳进入瓦比；一段任务取决于选择玛格丽特或密语大师。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Japanese army is here.Consulate DocksThe hero rescues his companions and crosses Corinne into Wabbi; a mission depends on choosing Margaret or the master of Mystery.

unresolved.legacyText: 瓦比王侯面临暗影军团侵袭。先前选择的英雄决定达沙前庭或卓坎诺要塞路线；之后可选择救援罗鳩村，或夺回瑟伯欣花园。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero of the previous choice decided on the path to the front court in Dasha or fort Zhocanor; he could then choose to rescue Rohian village or take back the Saberhin Garden.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄与帕拉瓦·约克交易，学会搭乘巨奴虫穿越致命的硫磺地带，并在摩拉废墟击败瓦蕾丝；此时黑暗逆袭已经侵入现实。
unresolved.englishDraft: Heroes trade with Parava York, learn to ride the giant insect through deadly.The Brimstone♪ The zone, andRuins of Morah Beating Wallace; right nowNightfallWe've got a break into reality.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄在折磨领域重遇寇米尔，解放受困灵魂，并在疯狂之门击败巫妖与白影。阿巴顿被击败后，逸散的力量威胁整个领域；寇米尔承接这股力量，成为掌管真相、知识与秘密的新神。
unresolved.englishDraft: Heroes met Komir in the torment, freed their trapped souls and wereGate of Madness Beating the Shaman and the White Shadow. Abbadon was defeated, and he got away.Strength Threatening the whole area; Komir takes over this.StrengthAnd become a new god in charge of truth, knowledge and secrets.

unresolved.legacyText: 角色从各自大陆的地震调查任务进入地下，结识奥格登与维克，并抵达北方之眼，与关及黑檀先锋队会合。
unresolved.englishDraft: The characters went underground from their own continent's seismic missions, met Ogden and Vic and arrived.Eye of the North Joining the Guang and Black Honolulu vanguards.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄召集乌拉、盖德与伦克等阿苏拉学者，保护魔像计划，并利用魔像突袭毁灭者巢穴。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero called together Assula scholars like Ulla, Ged and Lenk.PreservationAnd the Shaitans plan, and raid with them the den of the destroyers.

unresolved.legacyText: 关与英雄寻找失踪的黑檀先锋队，与反抗萨满阶层的夏尔烈焰战士皮雷合作，最终突袭要塞并解救兰玛队长等人。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Guang and the hero are looking for the missing Black Honolulus, and the Shire fire that fights the Samans.Warrior Pire cooperated, eventually raiding forts and rescued Captain Lama et al.

unresolved.legacyText: 英雄协助乔拉终结变为诺恩熊的兄长，夺回家园并保护诺恩的圣地，赢得诺恩的支持。
unresolved.englishDraft: The hero helped Jorah to end up being the brother of the Norn bear, take back his home and...PreservationNorn's holy place, won Norne's support.

unresolved.legacyText: 盟友集结后，英雄在席娃之心取得古老神器。贾里斯举行大矮人仪式，让多数矮人化为石矮人。联军深入中央传送室，击败大毁灭者，瓦解毁灭者的协同行动。
unresolved.englishDraft: After the ally was assembled, heroes gained their ancient powers in the heart of Sheva. Jarris held a Dwarve ceremony to turn most of them into rock dwarves. The coalition forces went deep.Central Transfer Chamber"and defeat the destroyer and destroy his concerted actions.

unresolved.legacyText: 前三项沙漠任务可按任意顺序完成，但飞升流程需要全部完成；这里并非三条互斥分支。
unresolved.englishDraft: The first three desert tasks can be accomplished in any order, but the flight process needs to be fully completed; not all three branches of each other are here.

unresolved.legacyText: 预言允许跳过部分前段任务；上述内容是剧情脉络，不表示每个任务都是通关必做条件。
unresolved.englishDraft: PropheciesThe fact that some of the previous tasks are allowed to be bypassed is a storyline and does not mean that each mission is subject to customs clearance.

unresolved.legacyText: 永恒之林与盖拉孵化所属于替代路线；继续主线不要求依次完成两条阵营路线。
unresolved.englishDraft: The Eternal Grove (explorable area)withGyala Hatchery (explorable area)It is an alternative route; the continuation of the main line does not require the completion of two camps in sequence.

unresolved.legacyText: 三项任务分别要求 Koss、Melonni、Tahlkora 随队。
unresolved.englishDraft: The three mandates require each of them. Koss、Melonni、Tahlkora Follow the line.

unresolved.legacyText: Pogahn Passage 与 Rilohn Refuge 是替代路线，分别要求 Margrid the Sly 与 Master of Whispers。Consulate Docks 和 Moddok Crevice 要求 Dunkoro；Venta Cemetery 要求 Koss；Kodonur Crossroads 要求 Zhed Shadowhoof。
unresolved.englishDraft: Pogahn Passage with Rilohn Refuge It's an alternative route. Separate requests. Margrid the Sly with Master of Whispers。Consulate Docks and Moddok Crevice Request Dunkoro；Venta Cemetery Request Koss；Kodonur Crossroads Request Zhed Shadowhoof。

unresolved.legacyText: Dasha Vestibule / Dzagonur Bastion 二选一；Jennur's Horde / Nundu Bay 也只需一项继续主线，后两者并非永久互斥。分别检查 Margrid / Master of Whispers、Koss / Melonni 的随队要求；Grand Court of Sebelkeh 要求 Tahlkora。
unresolved.englishDraft: Dasha Vestibule / Dzagonur Bastion Two or one;Jennur's Horde / Nundu Bay You can also check separately. Margrid / Master of Whispers、Koss / Melonni (a) The accompanying request;Grand Court of Sebelkeh Request Tahlkora。

unresolved.legacyText: 分别要求 Zhed Shadowhoof 与 General Morgahn 随队。
unresolved.englishDraft: Separate requests Zhed Shadowhoof with General Morgahn Follow the line.

unresolved.legacyText: 第二幕的阿苏拉、先锋队、诺恩三条故事线可以按任意顺序推进，最终需要全部完成；诺恩线中的后两条任务也有并列前置关系。
unresolved.englishDraft: The three storylines of Act II, Assula, the vanguard and Norn, can move in any order that ultimately requires all of them; the latter two tasks on the Norn line are also parallel.

numeric.english: Elite Bow Attack. If Oath Shot hits, all of your skills except Oath Shot are recharged. If it misses, all of your skills are disabled for 10…5…4 seconds. (50% miss chance with Expertise 7 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英弓術攻擊。命中時，除本技能外的所有技能立即完成冷卻。未命中時，你的所有技能被停用 10…5…4 秒。專精不高於 7 時，有 50% 機率未命中。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, Energy Boon raises the maximum Health of you and target ally by 1…3…3 for each point of your respective maximum Energy. When this enchantment is first applied, you and your target gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain an additional 1 Energy for every 2 points you have in Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。持續 36…55…60 秒，你和目標盟友各自每有一點能量上限，便增加 1…3…3 點體力上限。初次施加此加持時，你和目標各獲得 1…10…12 點能量；你的能量儲存屬性每有 2 點，你額外獲得 1 點能量。

numeric.english: Elite Item Spell. Hold Songkai's ashes for up to 45 seconds. While you hold her ashes, your spells and binding rituals cost -5…41…50% of the base Energy to cast.
numeric.chinese: 精英抱持魔法。手持 Songkai 的骨灰，最多持續 45 秒。持有期間，你的法術和縛靈儀式的能量消耗降低基本消耗的 5…41…50%。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。持續 40…60 秒，你的各項元素屬性提高 1。每次施放法術時，能量儲存每有 10 級，你獲得 1 點能量，並恢復相當於該法術能量消耗 100…300% 的體力。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。持續 40…60 秒，你的各項元素屬性提高 1。每次施放法術時，能量儲存每有 10 級，你獲得 1 點能量，並恢復相當於該法術能量消耗 100…300% 的體力。

numeric.english: Wroth's Holy Rod is a unique wand dropped by Wroth Yakslapper in Grenth's Footprint. There are two versions due to the December 8th, 2006 update.
numeric.chinese: 沃司神聖手杖是古蘭斯的足跡中犛牛打者烏司掉落的獨特魔杖。由於 12 月的 8、2006 更新，有兩個版本。

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * The Rotwing Recurve Bow is one of the items added to the game during the June 15, 2006 update.
* An easy way to get this item to drop is to tackle Rotscale while disguised as Keiran Thackeray in the Hearts of the North mini-mission, A Vengeance of Blades.
* Other items with this appearance:
**Ranger Forgotten Recurve Bow (unique)
**Ranger Forgotten Shortbow (unique)
**Ranger Keiran's Bow (Rotwing) (unique)
numeric.chinese:
維基註解：* 墮落反曲弓是 6 月 15、2006 更新期間加入遊戲中的專案之一。
* 掉落該物品的簡單方法是在極地之心迷你任務「A 復仇意志 of Blades」中偽裝成 Keiran Thackeray 對付惡臭骨龍。
* 其他具有此外觀的物品：
**遊俠被遺忘者反曲弓（獨特）
**遊俠被遺忘者短弓（獨特）
**遊俠 Keiran 的弓 (Rotwing)（獨特）

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * The Forgotten Fan was one of the weapons added to the game during the June 15, 2006 update.
* Other items with this appearance:
**Necromancer Frozen Fan (unique)
**Ritualist Tattered Fan (unique)
This item has serious clipping issues on female monks, female necromancers and female mesmers.
numeric.chinese:
維基註解： * 遺忘之扇是 6 月 15、2006 更新期間新增到遊戲中的武器之一。
* 其他具有此外觀的物品：
**死靈法師冰凍之扇（獨特）
**祭祀者破舊之扇（獨特）
該物品對女僧侶、女死靈法師和女催眠師有嚴重的剪裁問題。

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * The Totem Axe was one of the weapons added to the game during the June 15, 2006 update.
* The Totem Axe has a unique skin.
* The enchantments and energy boost make this item (plus Little John, Padraic, Rajazan's Fervor, Spirit of the Forgotten and Sharp Pointy Stick) especially popular among 55 monks/necromancers and Vow of Silence runners along with many other spellcasters.
numeric.chinese:
維基註解： * 圖騰斧是 6 月 15、2006 更新期間新增到遊戲中的武器之一。
* 圖騰斧具有獨特的皮膚。
* 加持與能量提升使該物品（加上小約翰、帕德里克、拉加辛的熱情、被遺忘者的精神和尖頭棒）在 55 僧侶/死靈法師和沉靜誓約跑者以及許多其他施法者中特別受歡迎。

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * The Ice Breaker has a unique skin.
* The Ice Breaker was added to the game during the June 15, 2006 update.
numeric.chinese:
維基註解：* 破冰槌具有獨特的皮膚。
* 破冰槌在 6 月 15、2006 更新期間加入遊戲中。

numeric.english: Wiki notes: *This collector was added (update of July 14, 2006) as a way to rectify an error that changed the stats of all Emboldened Carapace Shields, by allowing an exchange of an old shield for a corrected shield.

Wiki notes: * Other items with this appearance:
**Monk Ascalon Battle Staff
**Monk Gardock's Staff (unique)
**Monk Nifling's Staff (unique)
**Monk PvP Smiting Staff
**Monk Smiting Staff
* Prior to the October 25, 2006 update, Ziinjuu's Sanctuary had different stats. Those drops retain the original stats:
: Energy +5
: Holy damage: 7-10 (Requires 5 Smiting Prayers)
: Halves casting time of Smiting Prayers spells (Chance: 10%)
: Halves skill recharge of Smiting Prayers spells (Chance: 10%)
: Smiting Prayers +1 (20% chance while using skills)
: Health +10
numeric.chinese:
維基註釋： * 具有此外觀的其他專案：
**僧侶阿斯卡隆戰鬥法杖
**僧侶加爾達克法杖（獨特）
**僧侶尼夫林的法杖（獨特）
**僧侶 PvP 懲戒法杖
**僧侶懲戒法杖
* 在 10 月 25、2006 更新之前，孜英銖的聖殿有不同的統計資料。這些掉落保留了原始統計資料：
：能量 +5
: 神聖傷害: 7-10 （需 5 懲戒祈禱）
：懲戒祈禱法術的施法時間減半（機率：10%）
：懲戒祈禱法術的技能恢復減半（機率：10%）
：懲戒祈禱 +1（使用技能時有20%機率）
：體力 +10

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: *Ayoki is the only collector to offer a piece of armor with 35-55 AR prior to reaching Seitung Harbor. 
** Although his armor reduces damage taken by an average 4% compared to the armorers in Shing Jea Monastery (since the 20 AR difference leads to ~30% damage reduction, and the head piece is hit 1 time out of 8), it does not come with an attribute bonus.
numeric.chinese:
維基註解：*Ayoki 是唯一一位在達到青函港之前提供 35-55 AR 盔甲的收藏家。 
** 雖然與星岬寺中的護甲師相比，他的護甲減少了 4% 平均受到的傷害（因為 20 AR 差異導致〜30% 傷害減少，並且頭部件在 8 中被擊中 1 時間），但它沒有屬性加成。

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * This item used to be very popular when its stat was +10 armor, as it was the only method to gain more than +8 armor from a shield without meeting a requirement. This was changed in the December 20, 2006 update. 
*This item clips with the shoulder of Male Monks.
numeric.chinese:
維基註釋： * 當物品的屬性為 +10 護甲時，物品曾經非常受歡迎，因為它是在不符合要求的情況下從護盾獲得超過 +8 護甲的唯一方法。這在 12 月的 20、2006 更新中進行了更改。 
*此物品夾在男僧侶的肩膀上。

numeric.english:
Wiki notes: * This sword has a unique skin.
* This sword already existed in the beta version of the game, as can be seen in Issue #12 (December 2004) of the GuildMaster Photics Fansite Magazine, but it was not introduced until October 27, 2006 with the release of Guild Wars Nightfall as unique weapon. The original size was bigger and without the black dye applied, as can be seen in the inventory icon, but it's unobtainable. The original name of the weapon is not known either.

When wielded by a character, the sword is rendered black. When Dread Lord Onrah is seen wielding this sword, it is rendered similar to the inventory icon.
numeric.chinese:
維基註解： * 這把劍有獨特的皮膚。
* 這把劍已經存在於遊戲的測試版中，如問題＃所示 12 （十二月 2004 ）的 GuildMaster Phototics Fansite 雜誌，但直到 10 月才推出 27 , 2006 隨著釋放公會戰爭黑暗逆襲作為獨特的武器。原始尺寸更大並且沒有應用黑色染料，如庫存圖示中所示，但它是無法獲得的。該武器的原始名稱也不為人所知。

當角色揮舞時，劍會呈現黑色。當恐懼領主昂拉揮舞著這把劍時，它的渲染效果與庫存圖示類似。

numeric.english: Elite Bow Attack. If Oath Shot hits, all of your skills except Oath Shot are recharged. If it misses, all of your skills are disabled for 10…5…4 seconds. (50% miss chance with Expertise 7 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英弓術攻擊。命中時，除本技能外的所有技能立即完成冷卻。未命中時，你的所有技能被停用 10…5…4 秒。專精不高於 7 時，有 50% 機率未命中。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, Energy Boon raises the maximum Health of you and target ally by 1…3…3 for each point of your respective maximum Energy. When this enchantment is first applied, you and your target gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain an additional 1 Energy for every 2 points you have in Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。持續 36…55…60 秒，你和目標盟友各自每有一點能量上限，便增加 1…3…3 點體力上限。初次施加此加持時，你和目標各獲得 1…10…12 點能量；你的能量儲存屬性每有 2 點，你額外獲得 1 點能量。

numeric.english: Elite Item Spell. Hold Songkai's ashes for up to 45 seconds. While you hold her ashes, your spells and binding rituals cost -5…41…50% of the base Energy to cast.
numeric.chinese: 精英抱持魔法。手持 Songkai 的骨灰，最多持續 45 秒。持有期間，你的法術和縛靈儀式的能量消耗降低基本消耗的 5…41…50%。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。持續 40…60 秒，你的各項元素屬性提高 1。每次施放法術時，能量儲存每有 10 級，你獲得 1 點能量，並恢復相當於該法術能量消耗 100…300% 的體力。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。持續 40…60 秒，你的各項元素屬性提高 1。每次施放法術時，能量儲存每有 10 級，你獲得 1 點能量，並恢復相當於該法術能量消耗 100…300% 的體力。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Heals for 5…81…100. Heals for 30…98…115 more if target ally is below 50% Health.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文魔法。 5…81…100 的治療。如果目標盟友低於 50% 體力，則 30…98…115 的治療量會增加。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Causes 1…8…10 Energy loss. Deals 7 damage to target for each point of Energy lost and 75% of that damage to nearby foes.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文魔法。導致 1…8…10 能量遺失。每損失 1 點能量點，就會對目標造成 7 傷害，並對附近敵人造成 75% 點傷害。

numeric.english: Elite Hex Spell. (5…29…35 seconds.) Causes -2…4…4 Health degeneration and -1 Energy degeneration. Deals 15…63…75 damage if target foe's Energy drops to 0. Ends if this foe's Energy drops to 0.
numeric.chinese: 精英降咒魔法。 （5…29…35 秒。）導致 -2…4…4 體力衰減效果和 -1 能量退化。如果目標敵人的能量降至 0，則造成 15…63…75 傷害。如果該敵人的能量降至 0，則結束。

numeric.english: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). Bleeding creatures in range have -2 Health degeneration. End effect: Inflicts Bleeding condition (5…21…25 seconds) on creatures in range that have less than 90% health. Does not affect spirits.
numeric.chinese: 精英自然儀式。創造1…8…10級精神（30…198…240第二壽命）。範圍內的流血生物具有 -2 體力衰減效果。最終效果：對範圍內生命值低於 90% 的生物造成流血狀態（5…21…25 秒）。不影響精神。

numeric.english: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…150…180 lifespan). Deals 20…60…70 damage to creatures in range that reach 0 energy. Does not affect spirits.
numeric.chinese: 精英自然儀式。創造出1…8…10等級的精神（30…150…180壽命）。對範圍內達到 0 能量的生物造成 20…60…70 傷害。不影響精神。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Deals 10…42…50 holy damage and inflicts Burning (1…3…3 seconds) every second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文魔法。每秒（5 秒）造成 10…42…50 神聖傷害並造成燃燒（1…3…3 秒）。擊中目標初始位置附近的敵人。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Deals 30…110…130 holy damage. +20 recharge time if target foe is below 50% Health.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文魔法。造成 30…110…130 神聖傷害。如果目標敵人低於 50% 體力，則 +20 充電時間。

numeric.english: Elite Hex Spell. Interrupt a spell or a chant. Interruption effect: steal 5…13…15 Energy whenever target foe casts a spell (10 seconds).
numeric.chinese: 精英降咒魔法。 中斷咒語或聖歌。中斷效果：每當目標敵人施展法術時（10秒），竊取5…13…15 能量。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Deals 10…34…40 earth damage each second (5 seconds) and causes knock-down to attacking foes. Hits foes near target's initial location.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文魔法。每秒（5 秒）造成 10…34…40 地球傷害，並對攻擊的敵人造成擊倒。攻擊目標初始位置附近的敵人。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. (36…55…60 seconds.) Maximum Health for you and target ally is increased by 1…3…3 for each point of maximum Energy. Initial effect: Both gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain +1 Energy for every 2 points of Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。 （36…55…60 秒。）您和目標盟友的最大體力每達到最大能量一點，就會增加 1…3…3。初始效果：兩者皆可獲得 1…10…12 能量。 能量儲存的每個 2 點都會獲得 +1 能量。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. (40…60 seconds.) Your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。 （40…60 秒。）1 會增強您的元素屬性。每次你施展法術時，每能量儲存的 10 等級你都會獲得 1 能量，並且會獲得法術能量費用的 100…300% 的治療效果。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. (40…60 seconds.) Your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。 （40…60 秒。）1 會增強您的元素屬性。每次你施展法術時，每能量儲存的 10 等級你都會獲得 1 能量，並且會獲得法術能量費用的 100…300% 的治療效果。

numeric.english: Hex spell. Causes 5…8 Energy loss. Target and foes in the area have -1 Health degeneration for each point of Energy lost (10 seconds).
numeric.chinese: 降咒魔法。導致 5…8 能量遺失。 目標和該區域內的敵人每失去能量點（10 秒）就會有 -1 體力衰減效果。

numeric.english: Hex spell. Causes 5…8 Energy loss. Target and foes in the area have -1 Health degeneration for each point of Energy lost (10 seconds).
numeric.chinese: 降咒魔法。導致 5…8 能量遺失。 目標和該區域內的敵人每失去能量點（10 秒）就會有 -1 體力衰減效果。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Heals for 30…150…180. You gain 7 Energy if target ally was below 50% Health.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文魔法。 30…150…180 的治療。如果目標盟友低於 50% 體力，您將獲得 7 能量。

numeric.english: Shout. (4 seconds plus 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership.) Reduces damage by 20…35% for party members in earshot. End effect: heals for 35…60 Health.
numeric.chinese: 戰嚎。 （4 秒加上領導中每個 2 等級的 1 秒。）減少 20…35% 對聽力範圍內的隊員造成的傷害。最終效果：治癒 35…60 體力。

numeric.english: Contrary to descriptions, this skill inflicts -5…8 Health degeneration in the area over 10 seconds regardless of the amount of energy lost.
numeric.chinese: 與描述相反，無論損失多少能量，技能都會在 10 秒內的區域內造成 -5…8 體力衰減效果。

numeric.english: Contrary to descriptions, this skill inflicts -5…8 Health degeneration in the area over 10 seconds regardless of the amount of energy lost.
numeric.chinese: 與描述相反，無論損失多少能量，技能都會在 10 秒內的區域內造成 -5…8 體力衰減效果。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. Bring target dead party member back to life at full Health and full Energy. If you stop maintaining this enchantment or if this enchantment is removed, that party member dies and leaves an exploited corpse. Deaths while enchanted with Unyielding Aura do not incur a death penalty. (50% failure chance with Divine Favor 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。復活目標死亡隊員，使其體力與能量全滿。若你停止維持此加持，或此加持被移除，該隊員便會死亡，並留下已被利用的屍體。受堅毅靈氣加持期間死亡不會產生死亡懲罰。（神恩為 4 或以下時，有 50% 機率失敗。）

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Interrupts the target foe's action. If that action is a skill, that foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down for 2…3…3 seconds. (50% failure chance with Fast Casting 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文。中斷目標敵人的動作。若該動作是技能，將目標及其所有鄰近敵人擊倒 2…3…3 秒。快速施法不高於 4 時，有 50% 機率失敗。

numeric.english: * This boss has six possible spawn locations in Grenth's Footprint, which he shares with five other Stone Summit bosses .
numeric.chinese: * 該 Boss 在古蘭斯的足跡中有 6 個可能的生成位置，他與其他 5 個石峰矮人 Boss 分享這些位置。

numeric.english: * This boss shares only four spawn points with four other bosses: Sakalo Yawpyawl, Salani Pippip, Karobo Dimdim, and Alana Kepkep. This means that a random one of these five will not spawn per map instance.
numeric.chinese: * 此 Boss 僅與其他 4 個 Boss 共享 4 個生成點：薩卡老堯普堯爾、薩拉尼皮皮、卡羅柏迪姆迪姆和 Alana Kepkep。這意味著每個地圖例項不會產生這五個中的隨機一個。

Warrior Silver Eagle armor is a prestige art type available in the Guild Wars Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



*This armor is exclusive to warriors; there is no equivalent for other professions.
*Since the September 28, 2007 game update, this armor set can be added to the Hall of Monuments.

numeric.english:
Monk Labyrinthine armor is a prestige art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign in the May 24th, 2007 update. 

The standard versions of this armor are Monk Dragon armor and Monk Star armor, and there is also another prestige variant called Monk Flowing armor.



* This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Exclusive Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
* This armor uses the same inventory icons as Monk Dragon armor.
* The necklace can only be seen if your guild cape is turned off.
* The female version's legs will occasionally clip through the skirt when raised high; this is easily seen during the dance animation.

* 該裝甲在史蹟殿堂的「韌性」紀念碑中標記為馬翰洞穴獨家防禦。

* 女版高抬腿時偶爾會夾破裙子；這在舞蹈動畫中很容易看出。

numeric.english:
Korshek's group includes several Roaring Ethers and at least one other Djinn. There are also up to three satellite groups, each consisting of more Djinn and Roaring Ethers. In hard mode, Ruby Djinn can hit very hard with Liquid Flame (over 200 damage) and Korshek follows with Searing Flames which can deal over 250 damage against 60 armor rating characters. This means, even with no death penalty, the entire party can be wiped in two to three hits, as these are AoE attacks. Consider getting the Shielding Branches blessing from the Melandru's Watcher outside of Tihark Orchard to reduce the damage caused by Korshek and Ruby Djinn.

=== Skill recommendations ===

; Countering Searing Flames
There are several techniques to effectively counter Searing Flames:
* Bring skills that interrupt or inflict Dazed.
* Use Frigid Armor to prevent being set on fire. 
* Signet of Humility will prevent Searing Flames from being cast; Diversion will disable it for an extended period.
* The boss will quickly kill itself while hexed with either Pain Inverter or Spoil Victor.

; Other skills

* Ward Against Elements or Ward Against Harm will reduce the elemental damage.
* Winter converts all elemental damage to cold damage, which deals more damage to Ruby Djinns.
* Extinguish and Breath of the Great Dwarf remove Burning from all party members.
* Frozen Soil will prevent the Roaring Ethers from using Resurrection Signet.
* The ethers are the only fleshy foes in Korshek's group, so it does not help much to bring skills that cause Bleeding, Disease, or Poison; similarly, skills that exploit corpses are ineffective for this battle.
* Consider going to open the Do Not Touch Treasure in Forum Highlands after killing Korshek the Immolated, which is near the boss' location.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
numeric.chinese:
Korshek 的團隊包括幾個 Roaring Ethers 和至少一個其他巨靈怪。還有多達三個衛星組，每個衛星組由更多的巨靈怪和 Roaring Ethers 組成。在困難模式下，紅寶石巨靈可以使用液態火焰進行非常猛烈的攻擊（超過 200 傷害），而 Korshek 則使用爆裂火焰，它可以對 60 裝甲等級角色造成超過 250 的傷害。這意味著，即使沒有死刑，整個隊伍也可以在兩到三擊中被消滅，因為這些都是範圍性攻擊。考慮從提哈克果園外的梅蘭朵守望者那裡獲得遮蔽樹枝的祝福，以減少 Korshek 和紅寶石巨靈造成的傷害。

=== 技能建議 ===

;對抗爆裂火焰
有多種技術可以有效對抗爆裂火焰：
* 帶來打斷或造成暈眩的技能。
* 使用冰凍護甲防止起火。 
* 謙卑紋章將阻止爆裂火焰被施放； 牽制將長時間停用它。
* 當使用苦痛變頻器或勝者的掠奪施咒時，Boss 會快速自殺。

;其他技能

* 元素結界或守護結界將減少元素傷害。
* 寒冬將所有元素傷害轉化為寒冷傷害，這對紅寶石魔靈造成更多傷害。
* 熄滅和偉大矮人的呼吸消除了所有隊伍成員的燃燒。
* 凍土將阻止咆哮以太使用復活紋章。
* 以太是Korshek團隊中唯一的肉質敵人，因此帶來導致流血、疾病或中毒的技能並沒有多大幫助；同樣的，利用屍體的技能對於這場戰鬥也是無效的。
* 殺死靠近boss位置的宰殺者科薛克後，考慮開啟高地廣場中的請勿觸控寶藏。
完成記錄屬於接受任務的輪替。它不會改變永久技能或征服進步。

完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。

numeric.english:
*Consider holding this quest for three days until the quest to vanquish neighboring Ettin's Back also comes up.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
numeric.chinese:
* 可考慮接取後保留此任務 3 天，等鄰近雙頭怪隱匿地的清圖任務輪到時再一同進行。

完成記錄歸屬接取任務時的輪換期，不會改變永久技能或清圖進度。

numeric.english: In Hard mode, foes have a constant seven pips of health regeneration.
numeric.chinese: 在困難模式中，敵人有恆定的 7 點生命恢復。

references.title: Guide to The Fissure of Woe

numeric.english: Your party has completed [0...10] of 10 quests.
numeric.chinese: 你的隊伍已完成 10 項任務中的 [0...10] 項。

numeric.english: In Hard mode, foes have a constant seven pips of health regeneration.
numeric.chinese: 在困難模式中，敵人有恆定的 7 點生命恢復。

numeric.english: This quest was added as part of the May 27th, 2026 update.
numeric.chinese: 此任務是作為 5 月 27、2026 更新的一部分新增的。

numeric.english: Assist Livia with collecting inscriptions from the inscribed ettins. You have collected [0...3] of 3 inscriptions.
numeric.chinese: 協助莉薇亞從 inscribed ettins 身上收集銘文。已收集 3 份銘文中的 [0...3] 份。

numeric.english: Lead Hamar against the skree harpies holding Dohjok quarry. [5...0] of 5 harpy groups remaining.
numeric.chinese: 帶領哈馬爾對抗佔據多赫約克採石場的斯克雷鷹身女妖。剩餘 5 鷹身女妖組的 [5...0]。

numeric.english: *OPTIONAL* Destroy the watchtowers with explosive charges. [0...2] of 2 destroyed.
numeric.chinese: *可選*用炸藥摧毀瞭望塔。 2 的 [0...2] 已損壞。

numeric.english: *OPTIONAL* Employ the siege devourers to fire explosive charges at the garrison. [0...2] of 2 fired.
numeric.chinese: *可選*使用攻城吞噬者向要塞發射炸藥。 2 的 [0...2] 已觸發。

numeric.english: Consider bringing skills that protect against elemental damage since 10 of the 22 types of foes during this quest have skills that cause elemental damage.
numeric.chinese: 考慮攜帶可以防止元素傷害的技能，因為在此任務中 22 型別的敵人的 10 擁有會造成元素傷害的技能。

numeric.english: Consider bringing Mantra of Flame, since 8 of the 22 types of foes during this quest have skills that cause fire damage.
numeric.chinese: 考慮帶上火焰頌歌，因為在此任務中 22 型別的敵人的 8 擁有造成火焰傷害的技能。

numeric.english: Zoning out of the Cliffs of Dohjok before completing the quest causes it to be reset. Although your quest log will show you having collected 1 of the 6 scroll pieces, this is the piece acquired earlier during Big News, Small Package.
numeric.chinese: 在完成任務之前劃出杜夏懸崖會導致其重設。雖然你的任務日誌會顯示你已經收集了 6 捲軸碎片中的 1，但這是先前在大最新訊息小包裝期間獲得的碎片。

numeric.english: Find the 2 ingredients needed to make an antidote for the coming sickness, nong berries and tai ling buds. You have found [0..2] of 2 ingredients.
numeric.chinese: 找到製作即將到來的疾病解毒劑所需的 2 成分、農漿果和尾靈芽。您已找到 2 成分的 [0..2]。

numeric.english: At the completion of this mission, you could have up to eight party members in Sunspear Great Hall (exceeding that outpost's normal party size); you can use this to vanquish the Plains of Jarin.
numeric.chinese: 完成此任務後，日戟大會堂中的隊伍成員最多可達 8 名（超出該前哨站的正常隊伍規模）；您可以使用它來擊敗賈林平原。

numeric.english: Take Koss as one hero and go into the Sunward Marches. You will see the first pair of Sunspears. Defeat the Kournan Guards to rescue them. Go northwest and afterwards straight north to rescue the next two pairs. Watch out for sentry traps as they will cause 100 armor-ignoring damage to anyone in the area every 5 seconds. Talk to Commander Suha in the northeast to gain access to Venta Cemetery.
numeric.chinese: 以寇斯為英雄，進入向陽邊境。您將看到第一對陽矛。擊敗庫爾南守衛來營救他們。向西北走，然後一直向北去營救接下來的兩對。小心哨兵陷阱，因為它們每隔 5 秒就會對該區域內的任何人造成 100 無視護甲傷害。與東北部的指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Suha 交談以進入文塔公墓。

references.title: And a Hero Shall Lead Them

numeric.english: [0...12] of 12 guard posts neutralized!

Twelve guard posts are located throughout this mission; they are marked on the map by a red flag if active and gray one if neutralized. If you approach and do not kill the guards quickly enough, you will be targeted by siege attacks. A progress bar indicates the amount of time you have, with different colors to indicate how rapidly they expire — from fastest to slowest, they are: red, blue, teal, green and gray.
numeric.chinese: 整個任務區設有 12 個哨所；如果它們處於活動狀態，則它們在地圖上會標有紅旗；如果被中和，則標有灰色旗。如果你接近但沒有足夠快地殺死守衛，你將成為圍攻攻擊的目標。進度條指示您擁有的時間量，並用不同的顏色指示它們過期的速度 - 從最快到最慢，它們是：紅色、藍色、青色、綠色和灰色。

numeric.english: Players who started the three required Wanted quests before the 19 November 2010 update might be forced to take the official umbrella quest, which is optional otherwise. If you are unable to move on to Riverside Assassination, speak to Murro in Lion's Arch and add The War in Kryta to your quest log.
numeric.chinese: 在 19 11 月 2010 更新之前開始三個必要的通緝任務的玩家可能會被迫接受官方保護傘任務，否則這是可選的。如果您無法繼續進行科瑞塔戰爭主線任務，請與獅子拱門中的穆羅交談並將科瑞塔戰爭新增至您的任務日誌中。

numeric.english: Players who started the three required Wanted quests before the 19 November 2010 update might be forced to take the official umbrella quest, which is optional otherwise. If you are unable to move on to Riverside Assassination, speak to Murro in Lion's Arch and add The War in Kryta to your quest log.
numeric.chinese: 在 19 11 月 2010 更新之前開始三個必要的通緝任務的玩家可能會被迫接受官方保護傘任務，否則這是可選的。如果您無法繼續進行科瑞塔戰爭主線任務，請與獅子拱門中的穆羅交談並將科瑞塔戰爭新增至您的任務日誌中。

numeric.english: Clear the way to the Fountain of Truth by defeating Justiciar Sevaan and his forces in Shaemoor. [10...0] of 10 groups remaining.
numeric.chinese: 在夏恩摩中擊敗正義塞瓦安和他的軍隊，掃清通往真理之泉的道路。剩餘 10 群組中的 [10...0]。

numeric.english: During the bonus: three Forgotten foes spawn after killing each boss. They will attack from the West (northernmost general's reinforcements), South (southeast general) and East (southwest general).
numeric.chinese: 獎勵期間：殺死每個 Boss 後會產生 3 個被遺忘者敵人。他們將從西邊（最北將軍的援軍）、南邊（東南將軍）和東邊（西南將軍）進攻。

numeric.english: Destroy the demons from the earth. [3...0] of 3 groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 消滅地球上的惡魔。 3 群組的 [3...0] 保留。

numeric.english: Weaken the Drought by killing the droughtlings at the Floodplain of Mahnkelon, outside the Waterworks. [5...0] of 5 groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 透過殺死水廠外馬恩科隆洪氾區的旱生物來減弱乾旱。 5 群組的 [5...0] 保留。

numeric.english: Weaken the Drought by shutting off the water pumps. [5...0] of 5 remain active.
numeric.chinese: 透過關閉水泵來減輕乾旱。 5 的 [5...0] 保持活動狀態。

numeric.english: You have followed [0...4] of Dunkoro's 4 remaining suggestions.
numeric.chinese: 您已遵循 Dunkoro 的 4 剩餘建議中的 [0...4]。

numeric.english: As an alternative to fleeing across the lake, you may retreat back into the cave until the Mursaat patrol has moved ahead of the party. They will clear out the Stone Summit foes on the path, but they might stop moving when they reach Darda Goldenchief. If they stop at this boss, they will need to be killed. They can be pulled into separate groups of six Mursaat each, and if you are patient a nearby catapult will thin their numbers. Try to avoid letting Evennia aggro the Mursaat; in particular, the party member whom she is following should not be the one to pull. Regardless, the Mursaat that remain alive will need to be killed, before you reach the boat.
numeric.chinese: 作為逃離湖面的替代方案，您可以撤退到洞穴中，直到馬賽特巡邏隊移動到隊伍前面。他們將清除路徑上的石峰矮人敵人，但當到達金首達勒塔時可能會停止移動。如果他們停在這個頭目面前，他們就需要被殺死。它們可以分成單獨的群組，每組有 6 個馬賽特，如果你有耐心，附近的彈射器會減少它們的數量。盡量避免讓伊凡妮雅攻擊馬賽特；尤其是她所跟隨的黨員，更不該是拉的人。無論如何，在你到達船上之前，仍然活著的馬賽特需要被殺死。

numeric.english: You have participated in [0...5] of 5 festivities.
numeric.chinese: 您曾參加 5 慶祝活動的 [0...5]。

numeric.english: There are three main techniques for successfully defending against the siege, based on where you confront the mobs: at the gates, with the king, or by taking the fight to the teleporter.
numeric.chinese: 成功防禦圍攻的主要技巧有3種，取決於你面對暴民的地點：在門口、與國王一起戰鬥，或在傳送點戰鬥。

numeric.english: [3...0] of 3 gates still stand.
numeric.chinese: 3 門的 [3...0] 仍然矗立。

numeric.english: [3...0] of 3 bombards still function.
numeric.chinese: 3 轟炸的 [3...0] 仍然運作。

numeric.english: [4...0] of 4 generals remain.
numeric.chinese: 4 將軍的[4...0] 仍然存在。

numeric.english: For the Master's reward on this mission only 5 of the 6 defensive structures need to remain.
numeric.chinese: 為了獲得此任務中主人的獎勵，只需保留 6 防禦結構中的 5。

numeric.english: You have saved [0...3] of 3 junundu young.
numeric.chinese: 您已儲存 3 junundu young 的 [0...3]。

numeric.english: Comfort Animal/Heal as One or a beast master build, since animal companions each enter a Junundu in this mission (unlike other locations with Wurm Spoors), which results in your party having more than eight Junundu wurms. They deal damage with attacks; however, they will not use Junundu skills and will not be resurrected by Junundu Wail (but will reappear, alive, beside their owner when they leave the Junundu).
numeric.chinese: 安慰動物/治癒合一或野獸大師構建，因為動物夥伴在此任務中各自進入 Junundu 亞龍（與地蟲 Spoors 的其他位置不同），這會導致您的隊伍擁有超過 8 個 Junundu 亞龍。他們透過攻擊造成傷害；然而，它們不會使用朱南杜技能，也不會被朱南杜哀嚎復活（但當它們離開朱南杜時，它們會活著重新出現在主人身邊）。

numeric.english: Since the spawns of the torment creatures are limited (only 2 spawns of 2 per spawn point and 4 spawn points) it is possible to kill all nearby demons while holding the entrance, making the fight against Varesh's second form much easier.
numeric.chinese: 由於折磨生物的生成數量有限（每個生成點和 4 生成點僅生成 2 和 2），因此可以在佔領入口的同時殺死附近的所有惡魔，從而使與 Varesh 的第二個型態的戰鬥變得更加容易。

numeric.english: [0...3] of 3 elite emissaries destroyed.
numeric.chinese: 3 精英使者的 [0...3] 被摧毀。

numeric.english: Close the torment rifts by slaying the portal wraiths. [5...0] of 5 rifts remain open.
numeric.chinese: 殺死傳送門幽靈來關閉折磨裂縫。 5 裂痕的 [5...0] 仍然開放。

numeric.english: After the Shiro'ken, the Undead Lich will open five Chaos Rifts, which will spawn a variety of enemies (Prophecies Titans, Margonites and Torment Claws) continuously as long as they remain open. These portals are guarded by three Portal Wraiths each, which must be defeated to close them. The Wraiths themselves are not servants of Abaddon and so the Lightbringer title and skills are ineffective.
numeric.chinese: 在白影軍團之後，不死系巫妖將開啟 5 個混沌裂隙，只要它們保持開啟狀態，就會不斷生成各種敵人（阿斯卡隆戰記泰坦、瑪貢尼特和折磨之爪）。這些傳送門均由三隻介面幽靈守衛，必須擊敗它們才能關閉它們。幽靈本身不是亞霸頓的僕人，因此光明使者頭銜和技能無效。

numeric.english: Find information regarding the chalice. Good responses: [0...3] of 3.
numeric.chinese: 尋找有關聖杯的資訊。好的回應：3 的 [0...3]。

numeric.english: Find information regarding the chalice. Bad responses: [0...3] of 3
numeric.chinese: 尋找有關聖杯的資訊。錯誤回應：3 的 [0...3]

numeric.english: Run along the passage until you get to the end, there is only one way you can go. You'll come to a bridge which looks down on the spot where Abaddon is imprisoned. There are three paths down to Abaddon from here, two to the binding points for each of his hands which are situated to the left and right and one which leads to where his head is bound in the middle. Two Graven Monoliths guard each of the binding points, a maximum of six are on the map at any one time.
numeric.chinese: 跑過沿著通道一直走到盡頭，只有一條路可以走。你會來到一座橋前，俯瞰著亞霸頓被囚禁的地方。從這裡到亞霸頓有 3 條路徑，兩條路徑通往他左右兩側的雙手繫結點，一條通往他的頭部被綁在中間的位置。每個繫結點都有兩個墳墓巨石守衛，地圖上同時最多有六個。

numeric.english: Find information regarding the chalice. Good responses: [0...3] of 3.
numeric.chinese: 尋找有關聖杯的資訊。好的回應：3 的 [0...3]。

numeric.english: Find information regarding the chalice. Bad responses: [0...3] of 3
numeric.chinese: 尋找有關聖杯的資訊。錯誤回應：3 的 [0...3]

numeric.english: All paths converge here. Upon reaching the wide open area with the closed door, several Stone Rain, two Stone Reapers and one Stone Soul will emerge from the stone pillars and gather around the Stone Judge boss. Try to intercept and take down one or two of the Stone Rains spawning next to you before they can join the group. Kill the Stone Judge last unless the Rains are overwhelming the party, since killing him causes Danika to rush towards the door to attempt to open it - whereby she aggros two Stone Crushers who awaken beside the doorway, and all surviving Elementals will also rush towards the door. Kill these to prevent them from interrupting Danika. The mission ends when Danika successfully opens the door, though this might be delayed a bit if she gets hit by falling boulders while opening it.
numeric.chinese: 所有路徑都匯聚於此。到達大門緊閉的開放區域後，數臺石之雨、2 臺石收割者和 1 臺石之靈將從石柱中出現，並聚集在石判 Boss 周圍。在石雨加入隊伍之前，試著攔截並擊倒在你旁邊生成的一兩個石雨。最後殺死石頭審判者，除非雨勢壓倒了隊伍，因為殺死他會導致丹妮卡衝向門試圖開啟它——她會激怒兩個在門口醒來的碎石者，所有倖存的元素也會沖向門。殺死他們以防止他們打擾丹妮卡。當丹妮卡成功開啟門時任務結束，儘管如果她在開啟門時被落下的巨石擊中，任務可能會延遲一點。

numeric.english: Winning the Convocation gives you access to the Spear of Archemorus, an optional and recommended bundle item that can deal a max damage of 1900 at its level five when dropped (see its cumulative power here). Take it and head towards the Kraken boss, avoid aggro while fighting it.
numeric.chinese: 贏得集會後，您可以使用 Archemorus 的矛，這是一個可選且建議的捆綁物品，掉落時可在 5 級造成最大 1900 傷害（請在此處檢視其累積威力）。拿著它，向海妖頭目前進，在與它戰鬥時避免仇恨。

numeric.english: Boss five, if you chose Panaku, and he is still alive, the Acid Traps will be disabled making it possible for the party to stand where you like.
numeric.chinese: 頭目 5，如果你選擇帕納庫，並且他還活著，酸陷阱將被停用，使隊伍可以站在你喜歡的地方。

numeric.english: Introduced in the February 25, 2026 update.
numeric.chinese: 在 2 月的 25、2026 更新中引入。

numeric.english: If a player with at least 51 platinum talking to Ruthless Sevad selects the "Thief! Here's your five platinum..." option but hasn't clicked the following "Here's the money..." option, the player can drop all of their gold on the ground, click the "Here's the money..." option, and pick their gold back up to skip to the reward objective without actually paying the 51 platinum.
numeric.chinese: 如果至少擁有 51 白金的玩家與 Ruthless Sevad 交談，選擇“小偷！這是您的 5 白金...”選項，但沒有單擊下面的“這是錢...”選項，則玩家可以將所有金幣扔在地上，單擊“這是錢...”選項，然後撿起金幣以跳至獎勵目標，而無需實際支付 51 白金

numeric.english: Option 1: "Thief! Here's your five platinum... and not a gold piece more."
numeric.chinese: 選項 1：“小偷！這是你的 5 白金……不再是金幣了。”

numeric.english: The invading insects come as 3 waves of 2 groups each. All the groups spawn and approach from the portal to Jahai Bluffs nearby, so the party can easily intercept and destroy them by standing in front of the portal - just make sure you don't accidentally run through after a creature. Flagging heroes/henchmen near the first field below the portal is a good way to catch the first insect invaders as you return from accepting the quest. Correct placement also helps ensure all the attackers clear the portal but don't scatter over the fields.
numeric.chinese: 入侵的昆蟲以 2 組的 3 波的形式出現。所有隊伍都會從傳送門生成並接近附近的夏亥峭壁，因此隊伍可以透過站在傳送門前輕鬆攔截並摧毀它們 - 只需確保您不會意外地追隨生物即可。當你接受任務返回時，在傳送門下方第一個區域附近標記英雄/追隨者是捕獲第一批昆蟲入侵者的好方法。正確的放置也有助於確保所有攻擊者清除門戶，但不會分散在各個區域。

numeric.english: Kill insects and gather 10 Scarab Spores for Scholar Chago. 0...10 of 10 spores gathered.
numeric.chinese: 殺死昆蟲並為學者查戈收集 10 聖甲蟲孢子。 10 孢子的 0...10 聚集。

numeric.english: This quest was offered for the first time on July 22, 2009.
numeric.chinese: 此任務於 7 月 22、2009 首次提供。

numeric.english: To enter the Northlands, you must open the gate behind Torin by pulling the lever above it. While Torin insists you need a partner, you can pull the lever, enter the opened gate and proceed with the rest of the quest entirely on your own since the June 6, 2018 update.
numeric.chinese: 要進入北地，你必須拉動上方的槓桿來開啟託林後方的大門。雖然 Torin 堅持你需要一個夥伴，但自 6 月 6、2018 更新以來，你可以拉動控制桿，進入開啟的大門並完全自行完成其餘的任務。

numeric.english: This mission has a 10 minute time limit; however, additional time can be earned after rescuing a set number of refugees (+60 seconds every 25 people saved). Kurzick refugees come in groups of 1 - 4 from three different paths and head towards the portal. Approximately every 30 seconds, the next group spawns and makes its way toward the portal. Between the refugee spawn points and the portal is where several groups of Wardens spawn. As time progresses, more groups will spawn. Guard Karsten and Guard Uwe are standing next to the portal and will help fight any Wardens that get within range. They are not required to survive, but their presence is helpful.
numeric.chinese: 任務有 10 分鐘的時間限制；然而，在拯救一定數量的難民後可以獲得額外的時間（每拯救一個 25 人就需要 +60 秒）。 庫茲柯難民以 1 - 4 的形式從三個不同的路徑湧入，前往傳送門。大約每隔 30 秒，下一組就會產生並前往傳送門。在難民生成點和傳送門之間是幾組守望者產生的地方。隨著時間的推移，將會產生更多的群體。卡斯滕警衛和烏維警衛站在傳送門旁邊，將幫助對抗任何進入射程的守望者。它們並不是生存所必需的，但它們的存在是有幫助的。

numeric.english: This quest was first offered on June 1st, 2009.
numeric.chinese: 此任務首次於 6 月 1st、2009 提供。

numeric.english: This quest was added on November 18, 2010.
numeric.chinese: 此任務於 11 月 18、2010 新增。

numeric.english: Before the November 19, 2010 update, this quest was automatically placed in your quest log after witnessing Search for Allies if The War in Kryta was active.
numeric.chinese: 在 11 月 19、2010 更新之前，如果科瑞塔戰爭處於活動狀態，則在見證搜尋盟友後，此任務會自動放入您的任務日誌中。

numeric.english: The June 6, 2018 update made it possible for a solo player to travel to The Northlands. Killing the Oakhearts will allow for additional experience per run.
numeric.chinese: 6 月的 6、2018 更新讓單人玩家可以前往北國。殺死橡心隊將為每次奔跑帶來額外的經驗。

numeric.english: Corsair Commanders will give 5 seconds less time bonus for every 2 cycles.
numeric.chinese: 海盜對於每個 2 迴圈，指揮官會給予 5 秒少的時間獎勵。

numeric.english: This quest was first offered on May 10, 2009.
numeric.chinese: 此任務首次於 5 月 10、2009 提供。

numeric.english: Explore the area outside the Citadel and kill any remaining heket. [6...0] of 6 heket groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 探索城堡外的區域並殺死剩餘的赫克特。 6 heket 群組的 [6...0] 保留。

numeric.english: Destroy the binding guardians and free Razah. [3...0] of 3 guardians remain.
numeric.chinese: 摧毀束縛守衛並釋放雷薩。 3 守護者的 [3...0] 仍然存在。

numeric.english: Destroy the Charr forces to prevent the ritual from being completed. You have [3…0] groups remaining.
numeric.chinese: 摧毀夏爾部隊以阻止儀式完成。您還剩下 [3…0] 群組。

numeric.english: The elementalist boss is fought three times. The first two times he reaches 10% health, he will turn friendly, taunt the party, summon a large group of Shard Elementals and teleport to a side of the arena. His new location will be locked behind a crystal gate. To open it, you must kill the Shards elementals, pick up the Elemental Keystone one of them is carrying, and carry it to the crystal gate.
numeric.chinese: 元素系 Boss 戰鬥了 3 次。前兩次他達到 10% 生命值時，他會變得友好、嘲諷隊伍、召喚一大群碎片元素並傳送到競技場的一側。他的新位置將被鎖在水晶門後面。要開啟它，你必須殺死碎片元素，拿起其中一個攜帶的元素生物 Keystone，並將其帶到水晶門。

numeric.english: It takes only 29 runs in hard mode using Scrolls of Slayer's Insight (42,000 xp/run).
numeric.chinese: 只要使用《毀滅者洞察捲軸》(42,000 xp/run) 在困難模式下運作 29 即可。

numeric.english: 25 Dwarf reputation points per wave defeated, awarded immediately after each wave ends (End round 1 -- 25 points, End round 3 -- 75 points).
numeric.chinese: 25 每波擊敗的矮人聲望點，每波結束後立即獎勵（結束回合 1 - 25 積分，結束回合 3 - 75 積分）。

numeric.english: Each party member will be awarded 6000 Delver Reputation points should they break the quarterly record (3 months).
numeric.chinese: 如果每位黨員打破季度記錄（3 個月），他們將獲得 6000 Delver 聲譽積分。

numeric.english: On level 2 there are a total of five Dwarven Ghosts, even though the level has fewer than 30 enemies.
numeric.chinese: 在 2 關卡中，儘管該關卡的敵人少於 30，總共有 5 個矮人幽靈。

numeric.english: If using a survivor character, beware the boss right before the end - he can hit in excess of 150 before protection on an AL 40 target.
numeric.chinese: 如果使用倖存者角色，請在結束前提防 Boss - 在保護 AL 40 目標之前，他可以擊中超過 150 的目標。

numeric.english: It takes only 29 runs in hard mode using Scrolls of Slayer's Insight (42,000 xp/run).
numeric.chinese: 只要使用《毀滅者洞察捲軸》(42,000 xp/run) 在困難模式下運作 29 即可。

numeric.english: Korshek's group includes several Roaring Ethers and at least one other Djinn. There are also up to three satellite groups, each consisting of more Djinn and Roaring Ethers. In hard mode, Ruby Djinn can hit very hard with Liquid Flame (over 200 damage) and Korshek follows with Searing Flames which can deal over 250 damage against 60 armor rating characters. This means, even with no death penalty, the entire party can be wiped in two to three hits, as these are AoE attacks. Consider getting the Shielding Branches blessing from the Melandru's Watcher outside of Tihark Orchard to reduce the damage caused by Korshek and Ruby Djinn.
numeric.chinese: Korshek 的團隊包括幾個 Roaring Ethers 和至少一個其他巨靈怪。還有多達三個衛星組，每個衛星組由更多的巨靈怪和 Roaring Ethers 組成。在困難模式下，紅寶石巨靈可以使用液態火焰進行非常猛烈的攻擊（超過 200 傷害），而 Korshek 則使用爆裂火焰，它可以對 60 裝甲等級角色造成超過 250 的傷害。這意味著，即使沒有死刑，整個隊伍也可以在兩到三擊中被消滅，因為這些都是範圍性攻擊。考慮從提哈克果園外的梅蘭朵守望者那裡獲得遮蔽樹枝的祝福，以減少 Korshek 和紅寶石巨靈造成的傷害。

numeric.english: After accepting the quest, you will receive a bundle of Kurzick Supplies, which you must carry to Quartermaster Mikhail. Follow the map marker and fight your way through Ferndale. This quest triggers eight Luxon spawns along the various paths to Lutgardis Conservatory, though you will only need to encounter a few of them on the way, just dispatch them and go on. Should you drop the bundle along the route, it will ping the compass map to remind you to pick it up.
numeric.chinese: 接受任務後，您將收到一包庫茲柯補給品，您必須將其交給軍需官米哈伊爾。跟隨地圖示記並在蕨谷中殺出一條血路。此任務會沿著通往路嘉帝斯溫室的不同路徑觸發 8 個勒克森生成點，儘管您只需要在途中遇到其中的幾個，只需派遣它們並繼續即可。如果您沿著路線掉落包裹，它會 ping 指南針地圖，提醒您撿起它。

numeric.english: Find and capture the missing Fire Drakes: [5...0] of 5 remaining.
numeric.chinese: 找到並捕捉失蹤的火龍：剩餘 5 的 [5...0]。

numeric.english: Find and capture the missing Fire Drakes: [5...0] of 5 remaining.
numeric.chinese: 找到並捕捉失蹤的火龍：剩餘 5 的 [5...0]。

numeric.english: Help Pelei by slaying 10 Killer Iboga. You have slain [0...10] of 10 Killer Iboga.
numeric.chinese: 幫助佩雷殺死 10 殺手伊博加。你已經殺了 10 殺手伊博加的 [0...10]。

numeric.english: If using a survivor character, beware the boss right before the end - he can hit in excess of 150 before protection on an AL 40 target.
numeric.chinese: 如果使用倖存者角色，請在結束前提防 Boss - 在保護 AL 40 目標之前，他可以擊中超過 150 的目標。

numeric.english: Money Back Guarantee is a special quest available for characters that completed the Finding a Purpose quest before the April 5, 2007 update. Finding a Purpose required 4 gemstones, one of each type, to finish, which are no longer required.
numeric.chinese: 退款保證是一項特殊任務，適用於在 4 月 5、2007 更新之前完成「尋找目標」任務的角色。找到一個目的需要 4 寶石（每種型別各一顆）才能完成，但不再需要。

numeric.english: If using a survivor character, beware the boss right before the end - he can hit in excess of 150 before protection on an AL 40 target.
numeric.chinese: 如果使用倖存者角色，請在結束前提防 Boss - 在保護 AL 40 目標之前，他可以擊中超過 150 的目標。

numeric.english: Find and kill six bosses within Sorrow's Furnace. The quickest way to complete the quest is to kill the two bosses in the same chamber as Tharn Stonerift (Sorrow's Belly), take the southwestern path to the Stone Basilica and kill the two bosses there, and then return to Sorrow's Belly, take the east path, and turn south at the fork to clear out the Iron Arch and its two bosses.
numeric.chinese: 在悲傷熔爐中找到並殺死 6 個 Boss。完成任務最快的方法是殺死與薩恩·斯通裂谷（悲傷之腹）同一個房間的兩個boss，走西南方向的石大教堂並殺死那裡的兩個boss，然後返回悲傷之腹，走東邊的路，在岔路口向南清除鐵拱門及其兩個boss。

numeric.english: A good opening piece when you still need to use common pieces is the Skale because it does 150 damage with its spammable attack to enemies > 50% health and has two damage skills, both of which do a great deal of damage but take time to activate and thus benefit from facing a healthy opponent.
numeric.chinese: 當你仍然需要使用普通棋子時，一個很好的開局棋子是鱗怪，因為它通過對敵人> 50%生命值的垃圾郵件攻擊造成150傷害，並且有兩種傷害技能，這兩種技能都會造成很大的傷害，但需要時間來啟用，因此從面對健康的對手中受益。

numeric.english: Alert the scholars about the assault on the Halls of Chokhin. You have spoken to 0...8 of 8 scholars.
numeric.chinese: 向學者通報喬欣大廳遭到的攻擊。您曾與 8 學者的 0...8 交談。

numeric.english: Eliminate the groups of Margonites attacking Chokhin. 12...0 of 12 groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 消滅攻擊喬欣的瑪貢尼特部隊。 12 群組中的 12...0 保留。

numeric.english: Kill the demons infesting the Sebelkeh Basilica. 7...0 of 7 groups remain.
numeric.chinese: 消滅侵擾塞貝爾克大教堂的惡魔。 7 群組中的 7...0 保留。

numeric.english: The best method for gaining points is seeking and killing Lost Souls. Kill the first few Maddened Spirits until you have unlocked two areas. Then, start running in your wurm through the areas. There are three spawn points in the northwestern corner (one on rocky ground), three in the northeastern corner, one in the southeastern corner (on rocky ground) and two in the southwestern corner. When you start running, go through each area methodically, scanning for lost souls. Do not fight the Spirits. Let them chase you and use your tunnel skill to keep ahead of them. When you find a lost soul, make sure you have some space between you and the spirits before you kill it. Then, tunnel quickly away. This will take a while, but done effectively you can rack up many points.
numeric.chinese: 獲得積分的最佳方法是尋找並殺死失落的靈魂。殺死前幾個瘋狂的靈魂，直到你解鎖兩個區域。然後，開始在你的亞龍中奔跑穿過這些區域。西北角有 3 個生成點（1 個在岩石地面上），東北角有 3 個，東南角有 1 個（岩石地面），西南角有 2 個。當你開始跑步時，有條不紊地穿過每個區域，尋找迷失的靈魂。不要與靈魂對抗。讓他們追你，並利用你的隧道技巧保持領先。當你發現一個迷失的靈魂時，在殺死它之前確保你和靈魂之間有一些距離。然後，快速地隧道離開。這將需要一段時間，但如果做得有效，您可以獲得很多積分。

numeric.english: This quest appears to have been added after the November 30th, 2006 update.
numeric.chinese: 此任務似乎是在 11 月 30、2006 更新後新增的。

numeric.english: Originally, the Battle Axe (hatchet) that is given as reward in this mission, had different upgrades, allowing to put two grips at the same time. Doing this, for example, combinations of two Axe Grips of Enchanting were possible, providing a permanent +40% longevity in enchantments. This was modified in the December 20, 2005 game update and all the axes inside the game were forcibly changed to the current one (including the ones inside the inventory backpack).
numeric.chinese: 最初，在此任務中作為獎勵給出的戰斧（斧頭）進行了不同的升級，允許同時放置兩個握把。例如，這樣做可以組合兩個斧加持握把，從而提供永久的 +40% 加持壽命。這在 12 月的 20、2005 遊戲更新中進行了修改，遊戲內的所有軸都被強制更改為當前軸（包括庫存背包內的軸）。

numeric.english: This quest was used often for FFF prior to the November 13th 2008 update
numeric.chinese: 在 11 月 13 更新 2008 之前，此任務經常用於 FFF

numeric.english: This quest was used for Kurzick fast faction farming prior to the November 13th 2008 update, which added the requirement of killing the Luxon spawns (and moved the 4 spawn locations), significantly increasing the time required to complete the quest.
numeric.chinese: 此任務用於庫茲柯快速陣營值耕種，先前的 11 月 13 2008 更新增加了殺死勒克森產生的要求（並移動了 4 產生位置），顯著增加了完成任務所需的時間。

numeric.english: Help train the service staff by leading them into combat. Destroy 20 practice dummies in 3 minutes.
numeric.chinese: 透過引導服務人員參加戰鬥來幫助訓練他們。在 3 分鐘內摧毀 20 練習假人。

numeric.english: Because so many groups kill each other, it is possible to complete the vanquish by killing only around 175 enemies, despite there being over 240.
numeric.chinese: 因為如此多的團體互相殘殺，所以儘管有超過 240 的敵人，但只要殺死 175 左右的敵人就可以完成勝利。

numeric.english: Patrol the area and protect the Stone Singers from the raiding Luxon forces. 5 Stone Singers must survive. You have [8...0] out of 8 remaining.
numeric.chinese: 巡邏該地區並保護石歌者免受勒克森部隊的攻擊。 5 石歌手必須生存。 8 中還剩 [8...0]。

numeric.english: Aspect of Torment : While under this aspect, you take 50 damage every 3 seconds if you don't use a skill.
numeric.chinese: 折磨方面：在此方面下，如果您不使用技能，則每 3 秒就會受到 50 傷害。

numeric.english: Kanaxai is a difficult foe, as he hits very hard and very fast. Each successful hit also knocks his target down. He uses an enchantment called Nightmare Refuge (1-second cast time, 10-second recharge), which makes all spells fail 50% of the time, and gives him a 50% chance to block attacks. In addition, that enchantment also heals him for 1,000 health if it is not removed within the 10 seconds it lasts. And finally, like all of the Aspects of Kanaxai, he stops taking damage at 80%, 60%, 40%, and 20% of his maximum health. To resume normal damage, a knockdown is necessary (although life stealing skills continue to function). The difference between Kanaxai and his aspects are that each of Kanaxai's knockdowns will spawn a mob of twelve creatures:
numeric.chinese: 加奈賽是一個很難對付的敵人，因為他的攻擊非常猛烈且速度非常快。每一次成功的命中也會擊倒他的目標。他使用了一種名為夢魘避難所的加持（1 秒施法時間，10 秒充能），這使得所有法術在 50% 時間內失敗，並給了他 50% 格擋攻擊的機會。此外，如果該加持在持續的 10 秒內沒有被移除，它還會治癒他 1,000 的生命值。最後，像加奈賽的所有方面一樣，他在最大生命值的 80%、60%、40% 和 20% 時不再受到傷害。要恢復正常傷害，需要擊倒（儘管生命竊取技能仍然有效）。 加奈賽和他的面向之間的差異在於加奈賽的每次擊倒都會產生十二個生物的暴徒：

numeric.english: An efficient team can complete the quest in under three minutes (including travel time). With the Blessing of the Luxons active, you can earn 140-160 points, in addition to the 400 point reward for completing the quest. This translates to roughly 11,000 points per hour.
numeric.chinese: 一個有效率的團隊可以在三分鐘內完成任務（包括行程時間）。隨著 Luxons 的祝福啟用，除了完成任務的 400 積分獎勵之外，您還可以獲得 140-160 積分。這大約相當於每小時 11,000 點。

numeric.english: Roleplaying characters on accounts created prior to the January 19, 2006 update do not need to complete the Zaishen Challenge to acquire this quest.
numeric.chinese: 在 1 月 19、2006 更新之前建立的帳戶上的角色扮演角色不需要完成戰承挑戰來獲得此任務。

references.title: The Path of the Zaishen Elite

numeric.english: The elementalist boss is fought three times. The first two times he reaches 10% health, he will turn friendly, taunt the party, summon a large group of Shard Elementals and teleport to a side of the arena. His new location will be locked behind a crystal gate. To open it, you must kill the Shards elementals, pick up the Elemental Keystone one of them is carrying, and carry it to the crystal gate.
numeric.chinese: 元素系 Boss 戰鬥了 3 次。前兩次他達到 10% 生命值時，他會變得友好、嘲諷隊伍、召喚一大群碎片元素並傳送到競技場的一側。他的新位置將被鎖在水晶門後面。要開啟它，你必須殺死碎片元素，拿起其中一個攜帶的元素生物 Keystone，並將其帶到水晶門。

numeric.english: Your first task is getting a devourer egg to use as bait. You can earn two by completing The Egg Hunter quest involving Fadden Hathorn, to whom Pitney directs you at first. Alternatively, you can barter for one with local collectors: trade 5 skale fins to Brownlow or 3 dull carapaces to Rownan.
numeric.chinese: 你的第一個任務是取得一個吞噬者蛋作為誘餌。您可以透過完成採蛋者涉及 Fadden Hathorn 的任務來獲得 2 個任務，菲特尼首先將您引導至該人。或者，您也可以與當地收藏家進行物物交換：將 5 鱗鰭交易至布朗羅，或將 3 暗甲交易至羅南。

numeric.english: Gather 20 shells on the beaches in Mehtani Keys. You have gathered [0...20] of 20.
numeric.chinese: 在梅坦尼之鑰的海灘上收集 20 貝殼。您已收集 20 的 [0...20]。

numeric.english: This area is a popular choice for farming Norn title points. You can earn 4,000 points in Normal mode by clearing the area with The Path to Revelations active or 450 points per 5 minute run in hard mode by just defeating the Facets. You can earn around 20,000 points in Hard mode by clearing the area with The Path to Revelations active. See Norn farming for details.
numeric.chinese: 此區域是種植諾恩頭銜點數的熱門選擇。您可以透過清除具有通往啟示的道路活動的區域來在普通模式中獲得 4,000 積分，或在困難模式下每執行 5 分鐘只需擊敗 Facet，即可獲得 450 積分。在困難模式中，透過清除通往啟示的道路處於活動狀態的區域，您可以獲得大約 20,000 積分。有關詳細資訊，請參閱諾恩農業。

numeric.english: There are 2-3 hidden groups of oozes on level 2, in a low-ceilinged waterway.
numeric.chinese: 2 層的低矮水道中存在 2-3 隱藏的軟泥群。

numeric.english: Escort Oroku to the corrupted locations so that he can purify them. [0...3] of 3 purified. Oroku must survive.
numeric.chinese: 護送 Oroku 前往腐化地點，以便他能夠淨化它們。 3 的[0...3] 已純化。奧魯庫必須生存。

numeric.english: Enter the Undercity from the Wajjun Bazaar, via the Nahpui Quarter outpost. Since Oroku must survive stay near him at the areas of corruption and let the Kappa come to you. At each site, the Kappa will attack in 4 waves from each entry point in groups of 3 or 4. Since the Kappa are large groups of spellcasters, area of effect skills and caster shutdown will be very helpful. Oroku will stay with the party between the sites, so the only danger during movement is the Am Fah. Take care with these mobs, as it is easy to over-aggro and fail the quest. It is safest, though time consuming, to clear out the path before taking Oroku (either by not entering from south Wajjun Bazaar, or by running past before he finishes the dialogue.)
numeric.chinese: 從瓦江市場經由納普區前哨進入幽暗城。由於 Oroku 必須生存，請在腐敗區域靠近他，讓河童來找你。在每個地點，Kappa 將從每個進入點以 3 或 4 的群組進行 4 攻擊。由於河童是一大群施法者，範圍技能和施法者關閉將會非常有幫助。 Oroku 將在站點之間與隊伍待在一起，因此移動過程中唯一的危險是安費。小心這些小怪，因為很容易過度仇恨並導致任務失敗。儘管耗時，但最安全的做法是在進入 Oroku 之前清理出道路（要麼不從瓦江市場南部進入，要麼在他完成對話之前跑過去。）

numeric.english: Escort Oroku to the corrupted locations so that he can purify them. [0...3] of 3 purified. Oroku must survive.
numeric.chinese: 護送 Oroku 前往腐化地點，以便他能夠淨化它們。 3 的[0...3] 已純化。奧魯庫必須生存。

numeric.english: Your faction cap will increase by 1,000 Luxon faction the first time you finish this mission with 100 points or more.
numeric.chinese: 當您第一次以 100 或更多積分完成此任務時，您的陣營值上限將增加 1,000 勒克森榮譽值。

numeric.english: Drops during Special Treats Weekend in November
numeric.chinese: 11 月感恩節期間掉落

numeric.english: Wave 1, 2nd pair of groups
numeric.chinese: 波 1、2 第 2 對組

numeric.english: Wave 2, 2nd pair of groups
numeric.chinese: 波 2、2 第 2 對組

numeric.english: Wave 3, 2nd pair of groups
numeric.chinese: 波 3、2 第 2 對組

numeric.english: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. If a non-spirit creature within range dies, Edge of Extinction deals 14…43…50 damage to all creatures of the same type that are below 90% Health and within range of the spirit. This spirit dies after 30…198…240 seconds.
numeric.chinese: 自然儀式。創造一個等級 1…8…10 的精靈。若其範圍內有非精靈生物死亡，體力低於 90%、與死者同類且位於精靈範圍內的所有生物受到 14…43…50 點傷害。此精靈在 30…198…240 秒後死亡。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 40…60 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 Energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。在 40…60 秒內，您的元素屬性會因 1 而增強。每次施展法術時，每有 10 等級的能量儲存，你就會獲得 1 能量的價值，並且會受到法術能量費用的 100…300% 的治療。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 36…55…60 seconds, Energy Boon raises the maximum Health of you and target ally by 1…3…3 for each point of your respective maximum Energy. When this enchantment is first applied, you and your target gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain an additional 1 Energy for every 2 points you have in Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。在 36…55…60 秒內，能量恩賜會將您和目標盟友的最大體力提升 1…3…3，對應您各自最大能量的每一點。當此加持首次應用時，你和你的目標獲得 1…10…12 能量。您在能量儲存中每擁有一個 2 點，您就可以獲得額外的 1 能量。

numeric.english: Spell. Target foe is struck for 5…41…50 cold damage. If that foe is under the effects of a Water Magic hex, you gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。 目標敵人受到 5…41…50 寒冷傷害。如果該敵人受到水系魔法降咒的影響，則對於能量儲存的每個 2 等級，您都會獲得 5 能量加上 1 能量。

numeric.english: Glyph. For 25 seconds, your elemental attributes are boosted by 2 for your next 10 spells.
numeric.chinese: 符號。在 25 秒內，您的下一個 10 法術的元素屬性會因 2 而增強。

numeric.english: Trap. For 10 seconds, all adjacent allies are healed for 15…51…60 every 2 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
numeric.chinese: 陷阱。在 10 秒內，所有鄰近盟友每隔 2 秒就會受到治療 15…51…60。啟動該技能時，你很容易被打斷。

numeric.english: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 3…13…15 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 33% faster. When you activate this enchantment, all adjacent foes are interrupted. When this enchantment ends, all adjacent foes are interrupted. 50% failure chance unless Wind Prayers 5 or higher.
numeric.chinese: 閃現加持魔法。持續 3…13…15 秒，你的神喚使加持冷卻速度提高 33%。啟動此加持時，中斷相鄰所有敵人的動作；此加持結束時，再次中斷相鄰所有敵人的動作。若風之祈禱低於 5，有 50% 機率失敗。

numeric.english: Flash Enchantment Spell. For 3…13…15 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 33% faster. When you activate this enchantment, all adjacent foes are interrupted. When this enchantment ends, all adjacent foes are interrupted. 50% failure chance unless Wind Prayers 5 or higher.
numeric.chinese: 閃現加持魔法。持續 3…13…15 秒，你的神喚使加持冷卻速度提高 33%。啟動此加持時，中斷相鄰所有敵人的動作；此加持結束時，再次中斷相鄰所有敵人的動作。若風之祈禱低於 5，有 50% 機率失敗。

numeric.english: Spell. Create a Meteor Shower at target foe's location. For 9 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 7…91…112 fire damage and knocked down every 3 seconds.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。在目標敵人的位置建立一個隕石雨。在 9 秒內，該位置附近的敵人每 3 秒就會受到 7…91…112 火焰傷害並被擊倒。

numeric.english: Elite Bow Attack. If Oath Shot hits, all of your skills except Oath Shot are recharged. If it misses, all of your skills are disabled for 10…5…4 seconds. (50% miss chance with Expertise 7 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英弓術技能。若此攻擊命中，除此技能以外的所有技能立即冷卻完成。若未命中，你的所有技能停用 10…5…4 秒。（專精為 7 或以下時，有 50% 機率未命中。）

numeric.english: Hex Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes attack 50% slower for the next 5…25…30 seconds.
numeric.chinese: 降咒魔法。 目標敵人和所有相鄰敵人在接下來的 5…25…30 秒內攻擊 50% 的速度會變慢。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage from the next 10 attacks or spells, that ally is healed for 30…78…90 Health.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。在 8 秒內，每當目標盟友在下一次 10 攻擊或法術中受到超過 50 的傷害時，該盟友就會在 30…78…90 體力內得到治療。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, whenever target ally takes more than 50 damage from the next 10 attacks or spells, that ally is healed for 30…78…90 Health.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。在 8 秒內，每當目標盟友在下一次 10 攻擊或法術中受到超過 50 的傷害時，該盟友就會在 30…78…90 體力內得到治療。

numeric.english: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target ally has a Splinter Weapon. Target ally's next 1…4…5 attacks deal 5…41…50 damage to up to 4 adjacent foes.
numeric.chinese: 武器咒文魔法。在 20 秒內，目標盟友擁有爆刺武裝。 目標盟友的下一個 1…4…5 攻擊會對最多 4 的鄰近敵人造成 5…41…50 傷害。

numeric.english: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target ally has a Splinter Weapon. Target ally's next 1…4…5 attacks deal 5…33…40 damage to up to 4 adjacent foes.
numeric.chinese: 武器咒文魔法。在 20 秒內，目標盟友擁有爆刺武裝。 目標盟友的下一個 1…4…5 攻擊會對最多 4 的鄰近敵人造成 5…33…40 傷害。

numeric.english: Spell. Steal up to 10…54…65 Health from up to 1…3…4 foes in the area.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。從該區域內最多 1…3…4 的敵人處竊取最多 10…54…65 體力。

numeric.english: Spell. Steal up to 10…54…65 Health from up to 1…3…4 foes in the area.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。從該區域內最多 1…3…4 的敵人處竊取最多 10…54…65 體力。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. Bring target dead party member back to life at full Health and full Energy. If you stop maintaining this enchantment or if this enchantment is removed, that party member dies and leaves an exploited corpse. Deaths while enchanted with Unyielding Aura do not incur a death penalty. (50% failure chance with Divine Favor 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。復活目標死亡隊員，使其體力與能量全滿。若你停止維持此加持，或此加持被移除，該隊員便會死亡，並留下已被利用的屍體。受堅毅靈氣加持期間死亡不會產生死亡懲罰。（神恩為 4 或以下時，有 50% 機率失敗。）

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. All hostile animated undead in the area become bound to you. Verata's Aura ends after 120…264…300 seconds. When Verata's Aura ends, you lose your bond with any undead bound to you. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。區域內所有敵對的召喚不死生物改由你控制。此加持持續 120…264…300 秒。此加持結束時，你失去與所有受你控制的不死生物的連結。（死亡魔法為 4 或以下時，有 50% 機率失敗。）

numeric.english: Hammer Attack. Lose all adrenaline. Attack all adjacent foes. If this attack strikes a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is knocked down. (50% failure chance with Hammer Mastery 4 or less.)
numeric.chinese: 鎚術技能。失去所有怒氣，攻擊相鄰所有敵人。若此攻擊命中受到病症影響的敵人，該敵人會被擊倒。（精通鎚術為 4 或以下時，有 50% 機率失敗。）

numeric.english: Shout. (4 seconds plus 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership.) Reduces damage by 20…35% for party members in earshot. End effect: heals for 35…60 Health.
numeric.chinese: 戰嚎。 （4 秒加上領導中每個 2 等級的 1 秒。）減少 20…35% 對聽力範圍內的隊員造成的傷害。最終效果：治癒 35…60 體力。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 15…63…75 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) if target foe has 2 or more hexes.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。造成 15…63…75 傷害。如果目標敵人有 2 或更多降咒，則造成重傷病症（5…17…20 秒）。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 10…30…35 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds) if target foe has 2 or more hexes.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。造成 10…30…35 傷害。如果目標敵人有 2 或更多降咒，則造成重傷病症（5…17…20 秒）。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 5…24…29 fire damage each second (5 seconds) to location of target foe. Hits foes adjacent to your target. Inflicts Burning condition (3…6…7 seconds) on knocked down foes.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。每秒（5 秒）會對目標敵人所在位置造成 5…24…29 火焰傷害。攻擊目標附近的敵人。對被擊倒的敵人造成燃燒狀態（3…6…7 秒）。

numeric.english: Spell. Steals 20…56…65 Health. You begin Bleeding (6 seconds) if your Health is above 90%.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。竊取 20…56…65 體力。如果您的體力高於 90%，您將開始流血（6 秒）。

numeric.english: Pet Attack. Deals +5…29…35 damage. Deals +5…29…35 more damage if target foe is under 50% health.
numeric.chinese: 寵物攻擊。造成 +5…29…35 傷害。如果目標敵人的生命值低於 50%，則造成 +5…29…35 更多傷害。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 5…21…25 damage and causes 0…2…2 Energy loss each second (10 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。每秒（10 秒）造成 5…21…25 傷害並造成 0…2…2 能量損失。擊中目標初始位置附近的敵人。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 5…41…50 cold damage. Deals 5…41…50 more damage if target foe was above 50% Health.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。造成 5…41…50 寒冷傷害。如果目標敵人高於 50% 體力，則造成 5…41…50 更多傷害。

numeric.english: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals 10…22…25 damage every second (5 seconds). Inflicts Blindness condition (3…7…8 seconds) every second (5 seconds). Easily interrupted.
numeric.chinese: 陷阱。 （90 秒。）影響附近的敵人。每秒造成 10…22…25 傷害（5 秒）。每秒（5 秒）造成失明狀態（3…7…8 秒）。很容易被打斷。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. (40…60 seconds.) Your elemental attributes are boosted by 1. Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1 energy for every 10 ranks of Energy Storage and are healed for 100…300% of the spell's Energy cost.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。 （40…60 秒。）1 會增強您的元素屬性。每次你施展法術時，每能量儲存的 10 等級你都會獲得 1 能量，並且會獲得法術能量費用的 100…300% 的治療效果。

numeric.english: Elite Enchantment Spell. (36…55…60 seconds.) Maximum Health for you and target ally is increased by 1…3…3 for each point of maximum Energy. Initial effect: Both gain 1…10…12 Energy. You gain +1 Energy for every 2 points of Energy Storage.
numeric.chinese: 精英加持魔法。 （36…55…60 秒。）您和目標盟友的最大體力每達到最大能量一點，就會增加 1…3…3。初始效果：兩者皆可獲得 1…10…12 能量。 能量儲存的每個 2 點都會獲得 +1 能量。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Causes 1…8…10 Energy loss. Deals 7 damage to target for each point of Energy lost and 75% of that damage to nearby foes.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文魔法。導致 1…8…10 能量遺失。每損失 1 點能量點，就會對目標造成 7 傷害，並對附近敵人造成 75% 點傷害。

numeric.english: Hex spell. Causes 5…8 Energy loss. Target and foes in the area have -1 Health degeneration for each point of Energy lost (10 seconds).
numeric.chinese: 降咒魔法。導致 5…8 能量遺失。 目標和該區域內的敵人每失去能量點（10 秒）就會有 -1 體力衰減效果。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. (15…51…60 seconds.) Deals 20…56…65 lightning damage each time you create a creature to 5 foes near that creature.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。 （15…51…60 秒。）每次你創造一個生物並對生物附近的 5 敵人造成 20…56…65 閃電傷害。

numeric.english: Enchantment Spell. You gain 30…126…150 Health the next time damage drops your Health below 50%.
numeric.chinese: 加持魔法。下次傷害會讓您的體力低於 50% 時，您將獲得 30…126…150 體力。

numeric.english: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…150…180 lifespan). Deals 20…60…70 damage to creatures in range that reach 0 energy. Does not affect spirits.
numeric.chinese: 精英自然儀式。創造出1…8…10等級的精神（30…150…180壽命）。對範圍內達到 0 能量的生物造成 20…60…70 傷害。不影響精神。

numeric.english: Sword Attack. Deals +5…33…40 damage. Deals +5…33…40 more damage if target foe is below 50% Health. Lose all adrenaline.
numeric.chinese: 劍術技能。造成 +5…33…40 傷害。如果目標敵人低於 50% 體力，則造成 +5…33…40 更多傷害。失去所有腎上腺素。

numeric.english: Echo. (10…30…35 seconds.) Target ally gains 15…63…75 Health the next 5 times a shout or chant ends on that ally. Cannot target spirits.
numeric.chinese: 迴響。 （10…30…35 秒。） 目標盟友在下一個 5 喊叫或聖歌結束時獲得 15…63…75 體力。無法瞄準靈體。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 5…41…50 fire damage. You gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage if target foe is Burning.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。造成 5…41…50 火焰傷害。如果目標敵人處於燃燒狀態，則能量儲存的每個 2 等級都會獲得 5 能量加上 1 能量。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 5…41…50 cold damage. You gain 5 Energy plus 1 Energy for every 2 ranks of Energy Storage if target foe is hexed with Water Magic.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。造成 5…41…50 寒冷傷害。如果目標敵人被水系魔法施咒，則能量儲存的每個 2 等級都會獲得 5 能量加上 1 能量。

numeric.english: Glyph. (25 seconds.) Boosts your elemental attributes by +2 for your next 10 spells.
numeric.chinese: 符號。 （25 秒。）為你的下一個 10 法術提升你的元素屬性 +2。

numeric.english: Trap. (10 seconds.) Affects adjacent allies. Heals for 15…51…60 every 2 seconds. Easily interrupted.
numeric.chinese: 陷阱。 （10 秒。）影響鄰近的盟友。每 2 秒治療一次 15…51…60。很容易被打斷。

numeric.english: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…198…240 second lifespan). Bleeding creatures in range have -2 Health degeneration. End effect: Inflicts Bleeding condition (5…21…25 seconds) on creatures in range that have less than 90% health. Does not affect spirits.
numeric.chinese: 精英自然儀式。創造1…8…10級精神（30…198…240第二壽命）。範圍內的流血生物具有 -2 體力衰減效果。最終效果：對範圍內生命值低於 90% 的生物造成流血狀態（5…21…25 秒）。不影響精神。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 12…41…48 damage. Steals 12…41…48 Health if target foe's Health is above 50%.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。造成 12…41…48 傷害。如果目標敵人的體力高於 50%，則竊取 12…41…48 體力。

numeric.english: Hex Spell. (5…29…35 seconds.) Causes -1 Energy degeneration. Deals 5…41…50 damage if target foe's Energy drops to 0. You have -1 Health degeneration. Ends if this foe's Energy drops to 0.
numeric.chinese: 降咒魔法。 （5…29…35 秒。）導致 -1 能量退化。如果目標敵人的能量降至 0，則造成 5…41…50 傷害。您擁有 -1 體力衰減效果。如果該敵人的能量降至 0，則結束。

numeric.english: Spell. Deals 7…91…112 fire damage and causes knock-down every 3 seconds (9 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.
numeric.chinese: 咒文魔法。每 3 秒（9 秒）造成 7…91…112 火焰傷害並造成擊倒。擊中目標初始位置附近的敵人。

numeric.english: Elite Hex Spell. Interrupt a spell or a chant. Interruption effect: steal 5…13…15 Energy whenever target foe casts a spell (10 seconds).
numeric.chinese: 精英降咒魔法。 中斷咒語或聖歌。中斷效果：每當目標敵人施展法術時（10秒），竊取5…13…15 能量。

numeric.english: Elite Spell. Deals 10…42…50 holy damage and inflicts Burning (1…3…3 seconds) every second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target's initial location.
numeric.chinese: 精英咒文魔法。每秒（5 秒）造成 10…42…50 神聖傷害並造成燃燒（1…3…3 秒）。擊中目標初始位置附近的敵人。
