numeric.english:
See: Battery
* 2 energy regeneration for 4 seconds essentially gives each affected ally 2.67 energy.
* Due to its very short duration and spammability, this skill is exceptionally good for triggering echoes.
numeric.chinese:
請參閱：電池
* 4 秒的 2 能量再生本質上為每個受影響的盟友提供 2.67 能量。
* 由於其持續時間非常短且具有垃圾郵件性，該技能非常適合觸發迴聲。

numeric.english:
* Combine Echo and Arcane Echo to create echo chains, allowing you to use three copies of any single skill.
* If the next skill after Arcane Echo is not a spell, this enchantment will end with no effect.
* Arcane Echo will only recharge normally if no spell was copied. If a spell was copied, the copy remains for 20 seconds, after which Arcane Echo is disabled for 20 seconds.
** Consider using Auspicious Incantation before Arcane Echo for energy management, since the recharge time will not be increased.
* If used to copy a spell that can copy another skill or spell, the copy duration of that spell is used and will bypass Arcane Echo's 20-second copy duration.
** E.g., if used to copy Echo, whatever skill that is copied by the Arcane Echo version of Echo will remain as that skill for 30 seconds and then revert back to Arcane Echo.
*Arcane Echo's copying effect triggers first, before the effects of the spell that triggers it. For instance, when used to copy Gift of Health, the copy is disabled by Gift of Health's effect afterwards.
Arcane Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy itself.
{{Outdated info|}}
;February 05, 2019 update; please verify changes to AI behavior.
numeric.chinese:
* 結合迴響和魔法迴音建立迴聲鏈，讓您可以使用任何單一技能的三個副本。
* 如果魔法迴音之後的下一個技能不是咒語，則該加持將結束且沒有任何效果。
* 魔法迴音僅在未複製法術的情況下才會正常充電。如果複製了咒語，則副本將保留 20 秒，之後魔法迴音將停用 20 秒。
** 考慮在魔法迴音之前使用幸運咒語進行能源管理，因為充電時間不會增加。
* 如果用於複製可以複製其他技能或法術的法術，則使用該法術的複製持續時間，並將繞過魔法迴音的 20 秒複製持續時間。
** 例如，如果用於複製迴響，則迴響的魔法迴音版本複製的任何技能都會在 30 秒內保留為該技能，然後恢復為魔法迴音。
*魔法迴音的複製效果先觸發，然後才是觸發它的法術效果。例如，當用於複製體力贈予時，隨後體力贈予的效果會停用複製。
魔法迴音的描述忽略了它不能複製自身的事實。
{{過時的資訊|}}
；2月05、2019更新；請驗證 AI 行為的變更。

numeric.english:
* The caster receives the Death Penalty reduction when the hexed foe dies, regardless of who delivered the killing blow.
* If you kill a boss hexed with Asuran Scan, the order of effects is to your favor. You will first lose 5% Death Penalty and then gain the morale boost.
* This hex only applies to attacks that would be blocked and attacks affected by Blindness or skill effects that cause attacks to miss; it does not prevent hits from straying, being obstructed, or being dodged. It also does not prevent failure due to unmet requirements, e.g. Oath Shot will still fail 50% of the time if Expertise is below 8, and lead, off-hand, and dual attacks must still be executed in the correct sequence.
* This is the only hex without a specified activation time. It casts instantly, but it has an aftercast delay and cannot be used in mid-action.

Foes affected by this skill cannot miss.

While target foe is hexed, you cannot miss other foes.

This hex also prevents the target from blocking your attacks.
numeric.chinese:
* 當施咒的敵人死亡時，無論是誰造成了致命一擊，施法者都會獲得死刑減免。
* 如果你殺死了一個被阿蘇蘭掃描詛咒的 Boss，效果的順序對你有利。您將首先失去 5% 死刑，然後獲得士氣提升。
* 此十六進位制僅適用於會被格擋的攻擊以及受失明或技能效果影響而導致攻擊失敗的攻擊；它不能防止命中偏離、被阻擋或被躲避。它也不能防止未滿足要求而導致的失敗，例如如果專精低於 8，誓言之箭仍會同時失敗 50%，並且主攻、副手和雙重攻擊仍必須按正確的順序執行。
* 這是唯一沒有指定啟動時間的十六進位。它會立即施法，但有施法後的延遲，無法在行動中使用。

受此技能影響的敵人不會失手。

當目標敵人被施咒時，你不會錯過其他敵人。

這個降咒還可以防止目標阻擋你的攻擊。

numeric.english:
* Dash boosts speed enough to allow a character to pass through and trigger a trap without being affected.
* This skill increases average speed by 18.75% if used every time it recharges.
** Combine with Dwarven Stability for up to 6 seconds speed boost every 8 seconds and up to 37.5% average speed boost.
* Despite being linked to an Attribute, this skill does not benefit from that attribute in any way.
numeric.chinese:
* 急衝的速度提升足以讓角色通過並觸發陷阱而不受影響。
* 如果每次充電時使用此技能，平均速度會提高 18.75%。
** 與矮人穩定性結合，每 8 秒速度提升最多 6 秒，平均速度提升最多 37.5%。
* 儘管與屬性相關聯，但該技能不會以任何方式從該屬性中受益。

numeric.english:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* The effect stacks with other skills that boost attributes.
* The Energy Storage-dependent gain is rounded down, i.e. you receive no energy unless you have at least rank 10 in the attribute and can receive at most 2 energy with rank 20 or higher.
* The healing from this enchantment considers only the base cost of the spells, without any modifiers, such as Glyph of Lesser Energy or Quickening Zephyr.
numeric.chinese:
* 達到第一個效忠等級、庫茲柯/勒克森支持者、20 等級角色後，可以從庫茲柯理事或勒克森拾荒者學習此技能，以用於 3,000 陣營值。
* 庫茲柯版本的技能圖示位於頂部，勒克森版本的技能圖示位於底部。
* 此效果可與其他提升屬性的技能疊加。
* 與能量儲存相關的增益向下取整，即，除非您在屬性中的等級至少為 10，並且最多可以接收等級為 20 或更高的 2 能量，否則您不會收到任何能量。
* 此加持的治療效果只考慮法術的基本費用，沒有任何修飾符，例如微能符號或活力微風。

numeric.english:
Contrary to descriptions, this skill inflicts -5…8 Health degeneration in the area over 10 seconds regardless of the amount of energy lost.
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* Consider combining with Signet of Illusions if your allegiance rank is low and your Illusion Magic rank is high.
numeric.chinese:
與描述相反，無論損失多少能量，技能都會在 10 秒內的區域內造成 -5…8 體力衰減效果。
* 達到第一個效忠等級、庫茲柯/勒克森支持者、20 等級角色後，可以從庫茲柯理事或勒克森拾荒者學習此技能，以用於 3,000 陣營值。
* 庫茲柯版本的技能圖示位於頂部，勒克森版本的技能圖示位於底部。
* 如果您的忠誠等級較低且幻術魔法等級較高，請考慮與幻術紋章結合。

numeric.english: bug: Contrary to descriptions, this skill inflicts -5…8 Health degeneration in the area over 10 seconds regardless of the amount of energy lost.
numeric.chinese: bug：與描述相反，無論損失多少能量，此技能都會在 10 秒內的區域內造成 -5…8 體力衰減效果。

numeric.english:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Famine.
* Famine coupled with Sympathetic Visage and/or Ancestor's Visage is extremely powerful when used on a single tank who is absorbing damage. It is one of the combinations that becomes more and more powerful as the number of enemies (particularly melee enemies) increases.
* Energy must be at least 1 before dropping to 0 in order for Famine to deal damage (losing fractional energy gained by energy regeneration does not count).
numeric.chinese:
* 此技能創造出飢荒的精神。
* 飢荒與感同身受和/或先人容貌結合使用時，用於吸收傷害的單一坦克時非常強大。它是隨著敵人（特別是近戰敵人）數量的增加而變得越來越強大的組合之一。
* 能量在下降到 0 之前必須至少為 1，飢荒才能造成傷害（損失能量再生所獲得的部分能量不算在內）。

numeric.english: The recharge effect will occur if you attack more than one foe; thus, this skill will recharge even if you miss or are blocked.
numeric.chinese: 攻擊超過1名敵人時，會產生充能效果；因此，即使您錯過或被阻擋，該技能也會重新充電。

numeric.english: The recharge effect will occur if you attack more than one foe; thus, this skill will recharge even if you miss or are blocked.
numeric.chinese: 攻擊超過1名敵人時，會產生充能效果；因此，即使您錯過或被阻擋，該技能也會重新充電。

numeric.english:
* This skill will cause maximum health degeneration at rank 14 and above.
* The healing effect scales to be ~50% of the hex's maximum damage potential. For example, at rank 12, the skill will inflict a maximum of 216 damage, healing 113 points when it ends.
* You can increase the duration of the hex, increasing the net damage without affecting the amount of healing:
** Using Mantra of Persistence. (+1/2/3 seconds at 0/8/11 Inspiration Magic, respectively)
** By re-applying the hex before it runs out. 
* Removing the hex early (e.g. via Cure Hex) will trigger the healing. Use a cover hex to prevent this.
* The healing caused by Illusion of Pain does not trigger Scourge Healing.
* The AI only uses this skill on targets whose health is below two thirds of maximum.
numeric.chinese:
* 此技能將在 14 及以上等級造成最大程度的生命值退化。
* 治療效果縮放至降咒最大潛在傷害的~50%。例如，等級為 12 時，此技能會造成最大 216 傷害，結束時治療 113 點。
* 你可以增加降咒的持續時間，增加淨傷害而不影響治療量：
** 使用持久頌歌。 （分別為 0/8/11 靈感魔法的 +1/2/3 秒）
** 在降咒用完之前重新套用降咒。 
* 儘早移除降咒（例如透過治癒降咒）將觸發癒合。使用六角蓋可以防止這種情況發生。
* 苦痛幻覺引起的治療不會觸發災禍治癒。
* AI僅對生命值低於最大值三分之二的目標使用此技能。

numeric.english:
* The triggering damage is calculated before damage reduction, so a 55 Monk enchanted with Protective Spirit and Judge's Intervention could be dealt 60 damage, have that reduced to 5 damage, and still trigger Judge's Intervention.

* Combines well with minions, but will not trigger if they die due to their natural health degeneration.
* This skill can cause the highest armor-ignoring damage in one packet amongst all player-useable skills; however, Grenth's Balance can potentially cause a foe to lose more health.
Unlike most other monk spells, Judge's Intervention does not invoke an animation upon the target.
{{Outdated info|}}
;February 05, 2019 update; please verify changes to AI behavior.
* Heroes will use it on allies who have low health and are not in combat, such as minions when travelling between mobs.
numeric.chinese:
* 觸發傷害是在傷害減免之前計算的，因此附魔了精神守護和審判干涉的 55 僧侶可能會造成 60 傷害，減至 5 傷害，但仍會觸發審判干涉。

* 與小兵配合良好，但如果他們因自然健康退化而死亡，則不會觸發。
* 此技能在所有玩家可用技能中可以造成最高的一包無視護甲傷害；然而，古蘭斯的平衡可能會導致敵人失去更多生命值。
與大多數其他武僧法術不同，審判干涉不會對目標呼叫動畫。
{{過時的資訊|}}
；2月05、2019更新；請驗證 AI 行為的變更。
* 英雄會將其用於生命值較低且未參與戰鬥的盟友，例如在小怪之間旅行時的小兵。

numeric.english:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Life.
* This spirit heals 120-180 health throughout its lifespan with 12 ranks (or higher) in Restoration Magic.
** Effective when used with skills which reduces skill recharge time and/or destroys spirits to control the healing spike.
** Life will heal for 60-90 health if refreshed every 10 seconds upon recharge (with Ritual Lord).
* This spirit will also heal allied NPCs and members of allied parties, making it effective in large or multi party missions, especially with multiple minion masters since it also heals any allied minions.
This skill will create a spirit with an offensive appearance.
numeric.chinese:
* 此技能創造出生命的精神。
* 這種精神在其整個生命週期中治癒 120-180 健康，並在復原魔法中達到 12 等級（或更高）。
** 與減少技能恢復時間和/或摧毀靈魂以控制治療高峰的技能一起使用時有效。
** 如果在充電後每 10 秒重新整理一次，生命將恢復 60-90 生命值（使用祭祀之主）。
* 這種精神也會治癒盟軍 NPC 和盟軍成員，使其在大型或多方任務中有效，尤其是在多個小兵大師的情況下，因為它還可以治療任何盟軍小兵。
此技能會創造出具有攻擊性外觀的精靈。

numeric.english:
* It is best used as a sustained, passive self-healing skill, e.g. for navigating areas with health degeneration or numerous interrupts.
* It is a prominent optional component of 55 monk builds.
* It heals very slowly compared to other healing spells; however, it has relatively high healing when compared to other healing spells. For every 5 energy lost by the -1 energy degeneration, it heals for 90 health at rank 8 and 120 at rank 13.
numeric.chinese:
* 它最好用作持續、被動的自我修復技能，例如用於在健康狀況惡化或多次中斷的區域中導航。
* 它是 55 僧侶構建的重要可選元件。
* 與其他治療法術相比，它的治療速度非常慢；然而，與其他治療法術相比，它具有相對較高的治療效果。對於 -1 能量退化所損失的每一個 5 能量，它會治癒等級 8 的 90 健康狀況和等級 13 的 120 健康狀況。

numeric.english:
* This skill only recharges Resurrection Signet, Sunspear Rebirth Signet or Celestial skills if they were disabled by another skill (e.g. by Distracting Shot); it will not recharge them if they were used successfully.
* This skill is sometimes used by trappers, as it allows them to plant another set of traps or nature rituals without waiting out the long recharge time.
* Combine with Determined Shot, which recharges all your attack skills if it fails to hit. This can be used to rapidly recharge Oath Shot.
** This tactic can be extended with Shadow Sanctuary, which almost guarantees a miss.
** Add "Dodge This!" or Asuran Scan to the skill chain to ensure that Oath Shot hits through block and/or blind, bear in mind it will still have a 50% chance to miss when below 8 Expertise.
* The 50% miss chance is actually a 50% fail chance and cannot be prevented with effects such as Asuran Scan. Oath Shot will still go into recharge, unlike in regular attack skill failure.
numeric.chinese:
* 此技能僅在復活紋章、陽矛重生、紋章或天界技能被其他技能（例如震暈之箭）停用時才對其進行充能；如果使用成功，則不會為其充電。
* 捕獸者有時會使用此技能，因為它允許他們設定另一組陷阱或自然儀式，而無需等待漫長的充電時間。
* 與決心之箭結合使用，如果沒有擊中，它會為你的所有攻擊技能充電。這可用於快速為誓言之箭充電。
** 這個戰術可以用闇影 Sanctuary 來擴充套件，這幾乎肯定會失敗。
** 加上「閃避這個！」或阿蘇蘭掃描技能鏈以確保誓言之箭擊穿格擋和/或盲區，請記住，當低於 8 專精時，它仍然有 50% 機會錯過。
* 50% 錯失機會其實是 50% 失敗機會，無法透過阿蘇蘭掃描等效果來阻止。 誓言之箭仍會進入充能狀態，這與普通攻擊技能失敗不同。

numeric.english:
* This enchantment is still removable by non-targeted and non-spell enchantment removal, such as Signet of Disenchantment and Winds of Disenchantment.
* Maintainable using Glyph of Swiftness or Arcane Echo and a 20% Of Enchanting weapon mod at 15 or higher Earth Magic.
The armor bonus from this skill only applies to physical damage.
numeric.chinese:
* 此加持仍可透過非目標和非法加持移除來移除，例如覺醒紋章和反加持之風。
* 可使用 Swiftness 的符號或魔法迴音以及 15 或更高版本的地系魔法的 20% 加持武器模組進行維護。
此技能的護甲加值僅適用於物理傷害。

numeric.english:
* If used as soon and as efficiently (i.e., not going over maximum energy) as possible, this skill nets the equivalent of +2 pips of energy regeneration at 11-12 Channeling Magic and 2.4 pips at 15 Channeling Magic.
* Spirit Siphon will usually be superior to Offering of Spirit when spirits are available. It is non-elite, only returns 2 less energy than Offering of Spirit at rank 12 or higher, but can be used potentially more often resulting in more energy overall.
numeric.chinese:
* 如果盡快有效地使用（即不超過最大能量），該技能可在 11-12 導引魔法處獲得相當於 +2 點的能量再生，在 15 導引魔法處獲得 2.4 點的能量再生。
* 當有烈酒可用時，靈能吸收通常會優於生靈奉獻。它不是精英，僅在 12 或更高等級時返回 2 的能量比生靈奉獻少，但可以更頻繁地使用，從而整體產生更多能量。

numeric.english:
* Aside from Illusion of Weakness when at low health, and the elite Blood Is Power, this is the fastest skill to kill oneself. Verata's Sacrifice comes next.
** As of https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/Feedback:Game_updates/20260428 Update - April 28th 2026 - The Fastest way is Awaken the Blood, Masochism and any Well spell, which will sacrifice 102% maximum health at once, provided there are no corpses to exploit.
* Synergizes well with scythes, as well as attack skills that can deal multiple attacks.
* Foes in Hard Mode will use this skill even if they are the only member left of their team.
numeric.chinese:
* 除了生命值較低時的虛弱幻象和精英血量就是力量之外，這是最快殺死自己的技能。接下來是芙瑞達的犧牲。
** 自 https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/反饋:Game_updates/20260428 更新 - 4 月 28 2026 - 最快的方法是血之覺醒、受虐狂和任何井法術，這將立即犧牲 102% 生命值。
* 與鐮刀有很好的協同作用，並且攻擊技能可以進行多次攻擊。
* 困難模式的敵人將使用此技能，即使他們是團隊中僅存的成員。

numeric.english:
* Burning is refreshed every second that Ray of Judgment is active, e.g. a stationary target might burn as long as 7 seconds from a ray cast with a Smiting Prayers rank of 12 to 18.

Unlike other recurring ground AOE skills, AI units often will not try to leave until the effect is nearly expired.
numeric.chinese:
* 制裁目光啟動時每秒重新整理一次燒錄，例如懲戒祈禱等級為 12 到 18 的射線投射可能會使靜止目標燃燒長達 7 秒。

與其他反覆出現的地面 AOE 技能不同，AI 單位通常不會在效果快要過期之前嘗試離開。

numeric.english: * With this skill at 11 or more Healing Prayers, a party member is able to resurrect a 55 Monk even when the 55 Monk is at 1 maximum health due to Death Penalty (see 55 Monk for more details).
numeric.chinese: * 使用此技能在11或更高治療祈禱時，即使55 僧侶因死亡懲罰而處於1最大生命值，隊員也能夠復活55 僧侶（更多詳情請參閱55 僧侶）。

numeric.english:
* Damage inflicted by this skill is considered holy damage.
* If the target takes more damage than the stated maximum, then the damage taken will be reduced by that maximum and the attacker will receive the same amount. For example, at 14 Smiting Prayers, a target with Reversal of Damage on them being struck by a Lightning Orb that would deal 100 damage would take 30 damage and the attacker would take 70.
* The damage for this reversal is calculated before other damage reduction. So, a 55 Monk using Protective Spirit and Reversal of Damage can deal more than five damage, with the remaining (above the stated maximum for this skill) damage being reduced by Protective Spirit.
* This skill will still prevent damage even if there is no foe to redirect damage to, for example when struck by environmental damage.
numeric.chinese:
* 此技能造成的傷害被視為神聖傷害。
* 如果目標受到的傷害超過規定的最大傷害，則受到的傷害將減少該最大傷害，而攻擊者將受到相同的傷害。例如，在 14 懲戒祈禱處，帶有傷害反轉的目標被閃電球擊中（造成 100 傷害）時，將受到 30 傷害，而攻擊者將受到 70 傷害。
* 此逆轉的傷害是在其他傷害減免之前計算的。因此，使用精神守護和傷害反轉的 55 僧侶可以造成超過 5 點傷害，剩餘的傷害（高於此技能規定的最大值）會被精神守護減少。
* 即使沒有敵人可以將傷害重定向到該技能，例如受到環境傷害時，該技能仍然可以防止傷害。

numeric.english:
* The range for this skill is much shorter than the resurrection range of Comfort Animal.
* As of the August 6, 2009 game update and August 26, 2026 game update, Comfort Animal or Comfort Animal (PvP) can be used instead of Charm Animal for your companion to travel with you. Heal as One was updated with the February 25, 2010 game update to also have this functionality in PvE. These updates largely render Revive Animal suboptimal because of their ability to resurrect pets, mandatory bar placement for pet usage, cast time, recharge time, pet heal and range.
numeric.chinese:
* 此技能的範圍比安慰動物的復活範圍短得多。
* 自 8 月 6、2009 遊戲更新和 8 月 26、2026 遊戲更新起，您的同伴可以使用安慰動物或安慰動物 (PvP) 取代迷魅動物與您一起旅行。 治癒合一隨 2 月 25、2010 遊戲更新一起更新，在 PvE 中也具有此功能。這些更新在很大程度上使復活動物變得次優，因為它們具有復活寵物的能力、寵物使用的強制欄位置、施法時間、充電時間、寵物治療和範圍。

numeric.english:
*The damage is delivered in three independent packets. Adjacent foes are hit three times, nearby foes twice, and foes in the area only once.
**One-time damage reduction skills, such as Reversal of Fortune, and damage cappers, such Protective Spirit, do not fully protect against this skill, however skills that protect against multiple packets, such as Union, are more effective.
**Pain Inverter will deal damage back for each packet.
*Cracked Armor is applied before any damage.
The skill description implies that Blind covers Cracked Armor which covers Weakness, while in actuality Blind covers Weakness which covers Cracked Armor.
numeric.chinese:
*損壞的物品以三個獨立的包裹交付。相鄰的敵人會被擊中 3 次，附近的敵人會被擊中兩次，而該區域內的敵人只會被擊中一次。
**一次性傷害減少技能（例如幸運逆轉）和傷害限制器（例如精神守護）無法完全防禦此技能，但是防禦多個資料包的技能（例如聯合）更有效。
**苦痛逆變器將為每個資料包造成損壞。
*破裂的防禦在任何損壞之前應用。
技能描述暗示盲注覆蓋了破解的防禦，後者覆蓋了虛弱，而實際上盲注覆蓋了虛弱，後者覆蓋了破解的防禦。

numeric.english:
* You lose exactly 8 energy from the -4 pips over 6 seconds.
* If the signet is renewed before it ends, the caster will gain energy for each time the skill was activated.
* This skill will provide more total energy gain per second than Ether Signet.
* Signet of Recall is particularly useful:
**When encountering heavy energy denial, e.g. from a Mursaat Tower (the energy degeneration from Signet of Recall will have no effect since your energy has already been depleted).
**When you already have Ether Signet on your skill bar and need even more energy without having to use skills that require energy. 
**When you are facing many short battles (since Signet of Recall can be used right before the battle, during which time the energy degeneration is not disadvantageous).
**When energy hiding, you will not lose any energy from this skill while your current energy is 0.
numeric.chinese:
* 您在 6 秒內從 -4 點中損失了確切的 8 能量。
* 如果印章在結束前被更新，施法者每次啟動技能都會獲得能量。
* 此技能每秒提供的總能量增益比精神紋章更多。
* 紋章或回歸特別好：
**當遇到嚴重的能量拒絕時，例如來自馬賽特塔（紋章或回歸的能量衰減不會產生任何影響，因為您的能量已經耗盡）。
**當您的技能欄上已經有精神紋章並且需要更多能量而無需使用需要能量的技能。 
**當你面對很多短時間的戰鬥時（因為紋章或回歸可以在戰鬥前使用，在此期間能量衰退並不不利）。
**當能量隱藏時，當你目前的能量為0時，你不會因為該技能而損失任何能量。

numeric.english:
* The health gain at 12 Restoration Magic equals a health regeneration of 10.5 pips (21 pips within earshot of a spirit) and 13 pips at 16 Restoration Magic (26 pips within earshot of a spirit).
* Heroes will cast Spirit Light Weapon to overwrite non-defensive weapon spells when the target's health is at critical levels.

Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not healing.
numeric.chinese:
* 12 復原魔法的生命值增益等於 10.5 點（精神聽力範圍內的 21 點）和 16 復原魔法時 13 點（精神聽力範圍內的 26 點）的生命恢復。
* 當目標的生命值處於臨界水準時，英雄將施放靈光武裝來涵蓋非防禦性武器法術。

與簡潔的描述相反，該技能的條件效果會導致生命值增加而不是治療。

numeric.english:
* Spirits have four pips of energy regeneration; they regain their maximum energy (30 energy) in about 23 seconds.
** In Hard mode, enemy spirits have 41 energy, making them a better source.
** Spirits do not use energy to attack, so Spirit Siphon will not reduce their effectiveness.
* When used on multiple spirits, this skill allows for better energy returns over Offering of Spirit or Signet of Spirits (PvP).
* This skill always targets the spirit closest to the caster. If two or more spirits are equal distance, the target is chosen at random.
** There is no effect unless the closest spirit is within casting range; however, the skill will activate (and waste energy) with spirits outside of casting range or without spirits at all.
numeric.chinese:
* 精神有四點能量再生；它們在大約 23 秒內恢復最大能量（30 能量）。
** 在困難模式中，敵方靈魂擁有 41 能量，使它們成為更好的來源。
** 靈魂不會使用能量進行攻擊，因此靈能吸收不會降低其效果。
* 當對多個靈魂使用時，此技能可以比生靈奉獻或縛靈紋章 (PvP) 提供更好的能量回報。
* 此技能總是以距離施法者最近的靈魂為目標。如果兩個或多個靈魂距離相等，則隨機選擇目標。
** 除非最近的靈魂在施法範圍內，否則沒有效果；然而，當靈魂超出施法範圍或根本沒有靈魂時，該技能將啟用（並浪費能量）。

numeric.english:
* Combat stats at level 20 (rank 5 or above): 
** It will normally do three attacks between Stoning with one cast every 6 seconds. However, it benefits from its staff's chance for half recharge time of spells 20% of the time. On these occasions it will complete its second normal attack at 2.625 seconds before casting Stoning again (see Activation Time and Attack speed). 
** Its normal attacks deal between 16 and 46 earth damage on targets with 60 armor, and can benefit from weapon spells.
** It has 15 in Earth Magic.
** It has enough energy to use stoning 10 times during its lifespan, and will use it 9-10 times depending on the staff's recharge effect. As such, using a skill that reduces recharge time, like Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom, will not have any noticable effect unless combined with a skill that grants energy. 
* When the summon dies, it leaves a non-exploitable corpse. 
* The summoned Naga is not infused against Spectral Agony.
* Its Stoning works best if one or more members of the party inflict Weakness on targets. However, it will not always cast the spell on weakened foes.
* It is considered a non-spirit ally.

The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
numeric.chinese:
* 20 等級的戰鬥統計資料（等級 5 或以上）：
** 它通常會在石箭之間進行 3 次攻擊，每 6 秒施放一次。然而，它受益於其員工有機會獲得當時 20% 法術充能時間的一半。在這些情況下，它會在 2.625 秒內完成第二次普通攻擊，然後再次施放石箭（請參閱施展時間和攻擊速度）。 
** 它的普通攻擊對具有 60 護甲的目標造成 16 和 46 之間的土系傷害，並且可以從武器法術中受益。
** 地系魔法中有 15。
** 它有足夠的能量在其生命週期內使用石擊10次，並且根據法杖的充能效果將使用9-10次。因此，使用減少充能時間的技能，例如智慧者的黑檀戰旗，除非與賦予能量的技能結合使用，否則不會產生任何明顯的效果。 
* 當召喚物死亡時，它會留下一具不可利用的屍體。 
* 召喚的納迦並未註入對抗幽靈痛苦的能力。
* 若隊伍中的一位或多位成員對目標造成虛弱，其石箭效果最佳。然而，它並不總是對虛弱的敵人施展該法術。
* 它被認為是非精神盟友。

這個描述具有誤導性：每個玩家可以擁有一個有效的阿蘇拉召喚。

numeric.english:
While the functionality of this spell has changed with the June 24, 2026 update, its animation has not. There is no visible animation to highlight the new area of effect.
Contrary to other skills dealing Area damage over time (such as Fire Storm), this skill will fail if the target dies before the spell finishes casting.
numeric.chinese:
雖然法術的功能隨著 6 月 24、2026 更新而發生了變化，但其動畫卻沒有變化。沒有可見的動畫來突出顯示新的效果區域。
與其他隨時間造成區域傷害的技能（例如火焰風暴）相反，如果目標在法術施法完成之前死亡，則該技能將會失敗。

numeric.english: * The shortest recharging weapon spell (with a recharge time of 1s) is Ghostly Weapon. Since the rank in Communing affects only Ghostly Weapon's duration, it can be used effectively even at 0 Communing. Other short recharging item spells are Vital Weapon (2s), Vengeful Weapon, Weapon of Remedy and Xinrae's Weapon (3s). The activation time is of 1/4s for all those skills except Vital Weapon (1s). Other weapon spells that synergize with Wielder's Remedy have a recharge time of at least 5s for a casting time of 1s.
numeric.chinese: * 最短的充電武器咒語（充電時間為 1s）是幽靈武器。由於神諭中的等級僅影響Ghostly 武器的持續時間，因此即使在0 神諭中也可以有效地使用。其他短時間充電物品法術包括生命武裝 (2s)、復仇武裝、治療武裝和欣雷武裝 (3s)。除生命武裝 (1s) 以外的所有技能的啟動時間均為 1/4s。與指揮者療法協同作用的其他武器法術的充電時間至少為 5，施法時間為 1。
